0176957aef10.en: “Thanks—” Standing up, he crossed eyes with the large black bird chilling by the other seat, apparently looking at him with a “Yo!—got any more grub?” dead stare and a shuffling head. Ignoring the bird, he made himself out of the room, and saw a large rectangle with stairs going down in the middle, and two walkways on both sides that lead across the open concept room. Scratching his neck beard, Harry stood there, pausing for a second, looking towards the doors on the other side, or the stairs in front of him. If Eiri is not helping me, then who will?—why did she help me in the first place?
0176957aef10.t: “Terima kasih—” Berdiri, dia bertembung mata dengan burung hitam besar yang bersantai di tepi kerusi lain, nampaknya memandangnya dengan renungan mati “Yo!—ada makanan lagi?” dan kepala yang terteleng-teleng. Tidak mengendahkan burung itu, dia keluar dari bilik, dan nampak sebuah segi empat tepat besar dengan tangga turun di tengah, dan dua laluan pejalan kaki di kedua-dua belah yang menuju merentasi bilik konsep terbuka itu. Menggaru janggut lehernya, Harry berdiri di situ, terhenti seketika, memandang ke arah pintu-pintu di sebelah sana, atau tangga di hadapannya. Kalau Eiri tak tolong aku, siapa lagi?—kenapa dia tolong aku pada mulanya?

01dd91055dd1.en: “Not really—I mean, I tried to, but there are so many words I don’t know.” Harry made a culpable smile, his tone growing distant. “I thought you would help me.”
01dd91055dd1.t: “Tak juga—maksud saya, saya cuba, tapi ada banyak sangat perkataan yang saya tak tahu.” Harry membuat senyuman bersalah, nadanya semakin jauh. “Saya ingat awak akan tolong saya.”

01ef7d22d653.en: With his eyes widened, Harry saw her bending over, just enough to show a hint of exposed private skin. Harry squinted his eyes as hard as he could, trying to sharpen his vision even if just a smidge.
01ef7d22d653.t: Dengan mata terbeliak, Harry melihat dia membongkok, cukup untuk menunjukkan sedikit kulit tersembunyi yang terdedah. Harry mengecilkan matanya sekuat mungkin, cuba menajamkan penglihatannya walaupun sedikit.

0600c2efcd19.en: Harry opened his eyes again as he saw the stranger in gray hair walk past, ignoring Sora. He then saw Maiara, his future would-be wife, proudly smile at Neferteri with rakuja juice running down her cheeks like she was a happy pig after feeding from a trough. He looked down to his lap, and picked up the wet dirty towel resting on it to once again clean himself.
0600c2efcd19.t: Harry membuka matanya semula ketika dia melihat orang asing berambut kelabu itu berjalan melepasinya, tidak mengendahkan Sora. Dia kemudian melihat Maiara, bakal isterinya, tersenyum bangga kepada Neferteri dengan jus rakuja mengalir di pipinya seperti babi yang gembira selepas makan dari palung. Dia memandang ke ribanya, dan mengambil tuala basah yang kotor di atasnya untuk membersihkan dirinya sekali lagi.

06e2d4a31982.en: Walking further along, Harry noticed a large puke, and a black hair piece near it, coincidently about the size of Sora’s. What am I even doing at this point? Ignoring the nausea from the smell of the puke mixed with alcohol, he walked away from the lamps, into a darker part of the courtyard. Looking at the stars above, he saw them as hazy and out of focus points of familiar lights in a blanket of dark greenish hues. Somehow the freckles of light, and how they were spread throughout the sky felt normal, but the color of the night did not. Next, he looked at the lone moon, now higher in the horizon, shining a constant green bright green hue, as if protected by a shimmering veil. That doesn’t feel right—
06e2d4a31982.t: Berjalan lebih jauh, Harry perasan muntah yang banyak, dan sehelai cebisan rambut hitam berdekatannya, secara kebetulan kira-kira sebesar rambut Sora. Apa sebenarnya yang aku buat ni? Tidak mengendahkan rasa loya dari bau muntah bercampur alkohol, dia berjalan menjauhi lampu-lampu itu, ke bahagian halaman yang lebih gelap. Memandang bintang-bintang di atas, dia melihatnya sebagai titik-titik cahaya biasa yang kabur dan tidak fokus di dalam selimut warna kehijauan gelap. Entah bagaimana bintik-bintik cahaya itu, dan cara ia tersebar di langit terasa normal, tetapi warna malam itu tidak. Kemudian, dia memandang bulan yang tunggal, kini lebih tinggi di ufuk, memancarkan warna hijau terang yang berterusan, seolah-olah dilindungi tabir yang berkilauan. Itu rasa tak betul—

0981ebd50acd.en: “Eiri told you everything?” Harry looked at the muddy tea in his cup, imagining Eiri giving her pinky promise to him. Did she already break it?
0981ebd50acd.t: “Eiri cerita semuanya kat awak?” Harry memandang teh berlumpur dalam cawannya, membayangkan Eiri berjanji kelingking dengannya. Dia dah mungkir janji ke?

0a4be2a8bb9e.en: Sitting by her, Harry’s tightened clothes were again nearly exploding at the seams. His hairy gut was poking through the stretched fabric, including his belly button which shone through one of the holes—truly what a girl of cultured taste would consider a true panty-dropping sex appeal. Harry could not speak simply because the words weren’t coming up in his hectic brain. He felt his heart steadily grow faster, and his breathing erratic.
0a4be2a8bb9e.t: Duduk di sebelahnya, pakaian Harry yang ketat sekali lagi hampir meletup di jahitannya. Perutnya yang berbulu terjengul melalui fabrik yang teregang, termasuk pusatnya yang bersinar melalui salah satu lubang—benar-benar apa yang dianggap oleh gadis bercita rasa tinggi sebagai daya tarikan seksual yang membuat wanita tergila-gila. Harry tidak dapat bercakap semata-mata kerana kata-kata tidak muncul dalam otaknya yang kalut. Dia merasakan jantungnya berdegup semakin laju, dan nafasnya tidak menentu.

0a94a4a3fe35.en: The moisty warmth of the towel on his face felt like salvation. Harry’s reddened eyes were able to see something again, albeit they still burned, just like when you cut onions. He saw Eiri wrinkling her brow, worriedly looking back at him, while the rest of the table continually drank and ate. Amongst the voices, he heard Itagiba’s voice saying something along the lines of Gabiro fucking it up across the table to the girl in purple, and a guy in gray hair and horizontal-striped blue and gold clothing saying something back.
0a94a4a3fe35.t: Kehangatan lembap tuala di mukanya terasa seperti penyelamat. Mata Harry yang merah dapat melihat sesuatu semula, walaupun masih pedih, sama seperti ketika memotong bawang. Dia nampak Eiri mengerutkan dahi, memandangnya kembali dengan risau, sementara yang lain di meja terus minum dan makan. Di antara suara-suara itu, dia mendengar suara Itagiba mengatakan sesuatu tentang Gabiro yang merosakkan segalanya kepada gadis berbaju ungu di seberang meja, dan seorang lelaki berambut kelabu berpakaian jalur mendatar biru dan emas membalas sesuatu.

0ac946e5f76b.en: The maid’s face grew closer, wetting her lips. “Is that so?” Her voice shifted into stinging again. “So did you also forget that you need to ask people their name?”
0ac946e5f76b.t: Wajah pembantu rumah itu semakin dekat, membasahkan bibirnya. “Ye ke?” Suaranya bertukar menyengat lagi. “Jadi kau pun lupa kau kena tanya nama orang?”

0b77ed29ad17.en: “Princess Eori—” Neferteri slowly glanced at her, sipping her wine.
0b77ed29ad17.t: “Puteri Eori—” Neferteri perlahan-lahan mengerlingnya, menghirup wainnya.

0ee2fe41f2cc.en: I wonder where Maiara is right now? They haven’t said anything about her yet. Avoiding making too much eye contact with the people at the table, he directed his attention towards the strange metal flatware he was holding, playing close attention to its odd shape, a two-prong fork on one end, and a spoon on the other with wavy carvings in the middle that spelled out two words: Donas’ Picker? Oh! So that’s what a picker is! Harry remembered seeing that mentioned somewhere in one of the books he had glanced at. So it really is like a fork and spoon combined!
0ee2fe41f2cc.t: Mana Maiara sekarang agaknya? Mereka belum cakap apa-apa pun pasal dia. Mengelak bertentang mata terlalu banyak dengan orang-orang di meja, dia mengalihkan perhatiannya kepada sudu garpu logam aneh yang dipegangnya, memberi perhatian rapi pada bentuknya yang pelik, garpu dua cabang di satu hujung, dan sudu di hujung yang lain dengan ukiran beralun di tengah yang mengeja dua perkataan: Donas’ Picker? Oh! Jadi itulah picker! Harry teringat melihat perkataan itu disebut di suatu tempat dalam salah satu buku yang sempat dikerlingnya. Jadi memang macam garpu dan sudu yang digabungkan!

0f731b331d06.en: Eiri bit her lips, speaking from what appeared to be a canned response. “Because we trust the kingdom, rather than an individual from tampering with the contract. So—you really didn’t read it?” Her eyes shone with a motherly look as she clenched her gloved hands.
0f731b331d06.t: Eiri menggigit bibirnya, bercakap dengan sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti jawapan yang sudah dihafal. “Sebab kami mempercayai kerajaan, bukannya individu, untuk tidak mengusik kontrak. Jadi—kau betul-betul tak baca?” Matanya bersinar dengan pandangan keibuan sambil dia menggenggam tangannya yang bersarung.

0fb16c14d5a5.en: Eori’s cheek was red like a tomato, and she started to swallow. “Fucking bitch!” Eori forcefully took the towel from Sora’s hand, who rushed to her aid, and began cleaning after herself, including the blood slowly surging from within the side of her lips.
0fb16c14d5a5.t: Pipi Eori merah seperti tomato, dan dia mula membengkak. “Perempuan sundal celaka!” Eori merampas tuala dari tangan Sora dengan kasar, yang bergegas membantunya, dan mula membersihkan dirinya, termasuk darah yang perlahan-lahan keluar dari tepi bibirnya.

0fec75b57d76.en: “She didn't say?” Harry promptly replied, holding his diabetic-inducing citrusy tea.
0fec75b57d76.t: “Dia tak cakap pun?” Harry menjawab dengan segera, memegang tehnya yang bersitrus dan boleh menyebabkan kencing manis.

0ffc3fcf6c29.en: Arukia took another sip of her muddy tea, enjoying its somehow delectable flavors when a knock in the door interrupted their moment of Zen.
0ffc3fcf6c29.t: Arukia menghirup lagi teh berlumpurnya, menikmati rasanya yang entah bagaimana enak apabila ketukan di pintu mengganggu saat Zen mereka.

1009041e76ca.en: “What did you like the most?” Itagiba caught Harry’s attention.
1009041e76ca.t: “Apa yang kau paling suka?” Itagiba menarik perhatian Harry.

1229a000bda7.en: Noticing the maid making herself at home, Harry was still at the door, quite motionless, while his brain kept on processing the pantyless-ness of her situation. His mouth semi-opened, he vaguely stared at the maid, interlocking her fingers through her beautifully smooth dark brown hair, and sending them away from her face, all while perusing the book Harry was previously trying to read. Her crossed legs brought attention to her foot, slowly, but rhythmically kicking the air, but the longer Harry watched them dance around, the more intense its rhythm became.
1229a000bda7.t: Perasan pembantu rumah itu membuat dirinya seperti di rumah sendiri, Harry masih di pintu, agak kaku, sementara otaknya terus memproses ketiadaan seluar dalam dalam situasinya. Mulutnya separuh terbuka, dia merenung samar-samar ke arah pembantu rumah itu, yang menyelitkan jarinya ke rambut coklat gelapnya yang cantik dan licin, dan menolaknya jauh dari wajahnya, sambil meneliti buku yang Harry cuba baca sebelum itu. Kakinya yang bersilang menarik perhatian kepada kakinya, perlahan-lahan, tetapi berirama menendang udara, tetapi semakin lama Harry memerhatinya menari, semakin rancak iramanya.

12d525ec0540.en: “We talked about this. Dear!—please go to bed.” Neferteri placed her hand on his shoulder, and squeezed tightly.
12d525ec0540.t: “Kita sudah bincangkan perkara ini. Kanda!—sila pergi tidur.” Neferteri meletakkan tangannya di bahunya, dan memicit dengan kuat.

12e16498575d.en: “Sora, did you use my mother’s recipe on the Bagarisa?” Eiri glanced towards Sora.
12e16498575d.t: “Sora, kau guna resipi mak aku untuk Bagarisa tu ke?” Eiri mengerling ke arah Sora.

13d4f9006a3f.en: “Yes, my queen.” The tall maid at the door turned back towards the queen to excuse herself again.
13d4f9006a3f.t: “Baik, permaisuriku.” Pembantu rumah tinggi di pintu itu berpaling semula ke arah permaisuri untuk meminta diri sekali lagi.

13e1a92b9125.en: Harry did not feel much of the ball-shaped mark left on his forehead, for his eyes started burning as if he had spilled lime juice on it. He dropped his picker, and wiped away the juice and seeds with his hands, but the viscous and sticky nature of it prevented him from making any meaningful progress. Rather, he was mostly spreading the juice around his face.
13e1a92b9125.t: Harry tidak terlalu merasakan kesan berbentuk bola yang tertinggal di dahinya, kerana matanya mula pedih seolah-olah dia tertumpah jus limau nipis padanya. Dia menjatuhkan picker-nya, dan mengesat jus dan biji itu dengan tangannya, tetapi sifatnya yang pekat dan melekit menghalangnya daripada membuat kemajuan yang bermakna. Sebaliknya, dia kebanyakannya menyapu jus itu ke seluruh mukanya.

14dec8b233bb.en: “I’m not sure exactly. Like slightly earthy, comes in a blue thing wrapped in plastic wrap? Yeah! Kinda whitish, but I can’t quite remember the shape of the mushroom inside.” Harry saw himself picking up a blue box from a supermarket shelf, knowing it was mushrooms, but didn’t know its shape.
14dec8b233bb.t: “Saya tak pasti sangat. Macam rasa tanah sikit, datang dalam benda biru yang dibalut plastik? Ha! Agak keputihan, tapi saya tak berapa ingat bentuk cendawan kat dalam tu.” Harry melihat dirinya mengambil kotak biru dari rak pasar raya, tahu itu cendawan, tetapi tidak tahu bentuknya.

1500f84055ac.en: Eiri’s head slowly turned side to side, trying to remain serious, but soon after a chuckle surfaced, breaking her tension. “Take him to his room, please!” She spoke loudly.
1500f84055ac.t: Kepala Eiri perlahan-lahan bergeleng ke kiri dan kanan, cuba kekal serius, tetapi tidak lama kemudian ketawa kecil timbul, memecahkan ketegangannya. “Bawa dia ke biliknya, tolong!” Dia bercakap dengan kuat.

172c552b1b52.en: Harry made his way back to his room—well, as much as it was “his” room as someone going back to “his” hostel bed after spending the day walking about in a foreign country. It might feel like a home, relatively speaking, but for sure it isn’t.
172c552b1b52.t: Harry kembali ke biliknya—yalah, setakat mana ia bilik “dia” seperti seseorang yang kembali ke katil asrama pengembara “dia” selepas seharian berjalan-jalan di negara asing. Ia mungkin terasa seperti rumah, secara relatifnya, tetapi pastinya bukan.

1a1ef056144e.en: Neferteri keenly observed his puppy eyes towards Eiri. “Would you like us to give you a summary of it, or would you rather read for yourself?”
1a1ef056144e.t: Neferteri memerhati dengan teliti mata anak anjingnya ke arah Eiri. “Adakah kamu mahu kami memberikan ringkasannya, atau kamu lebih suka membacanya sendiri?”

1ab7b50c845c.en: “Awww—fuck!” The sounds of someone tumbling down the stairs followed by a splat on the floor echoed from outside the room. “—ahhhhhh—my back—I’m fine! I’m fine!—ow—my back.” Itagiba’s not-as-strong-willed voice echoed from afar.
1ab7b50c845c.t: “Adoiii—sial!” Bunyi seseorang terguling jatuh tangga diikuti hempasan di lantai bergema dari luar bilik. “—ahhhhhh—belakang aku—Aku okey! Aku okey!—aduh—belakang aku.” Suara Itagiba yang tidak segagah tadi bergema dari jauh.

1bb87049f1df.en: Lifting the rakuja above her head, right above her open wide mouth, Maiara squeezed the life out of it. Her forearm and hand muscles contracted hard enough to make the rakuja explode everywhere.
1bb87049f1df.t: Mengangkat rakuja itu di atas kepalanya, betul-betul di atas mulutnya yang ternganga luas, Maiara memerah nyawa keluar daripadanya. Otot lengan bawah dan tangannya mengecut cukup kuat untuk membuatkan rakuja itu meletup ke merata tempat.

1bfb582dc630.en: Harry looked at Eiri, who looked right back at him with a flat smile, and a stalled rigid posture. Feeling like the time had come, he dry gulped. “I—yes, please.”
1bfb582dc630.t: Harry memandang Eiri, yang memandang balik kepadanya dengan senyuman hambar, dan postur yang kaku dan terhenti. Merasakan masanya sudah tiba, dia menelan liur kering. “Sa—ya, tolong.”

1dd83fe58138.en: Eiri grabbed Neferteri’s badge, and gave it back. Rolling up the contract, she asked one thing—insinuating more of a demand than question. “When will you give him the opportunity to read?”
1dd83fe58138.t: Eiri mengambil lencana Neferteri, dan memulangkannya. Menggulung kontrak itu, dia bertanya satu perkara—lebih berbaur tuntutan daripada soalan. “Bila awak nak bagi dia peluang untuk membaca?”

22e187074190.en: “S—sorry” Fumbling through his delivery, Harry stepped aside, giving way to her as he scratched his head—the shit eating grin on him proved he was sorry, but not that sorry.
22e187074190.t: “M—maaf” Tergagap-gagap menyampaikannya, Harry melangkah ke tepi, memberi laluan kepadanya sambil menggaru kepala—sengih kerang busuk di wajahnya membuktikan dia minta maaf, tetapi tidaklah sangat.

24a02327cd12.en: Harry quickly, but firmly shook his head. “I saw the three sisters in the book, but it did not feel familiar at all.”
24a02327cd12.t: Harry menggeleng dengan pantas tetapi tegas. “Saya ada nampak tiga beradik tu dalam buku, tapi langsung tak rasa biasa.”

2a146f387e5b.en: Nina, feeling Maiara’s intention, stood up, and bent over the table, protecting her rakujas with her hands like a chicken protecting its chicklings from the rain. However, it was to no avail as Maiara’s hands firmly reached towards her rakujas. “NO! MAIARA! NO!” Nina struggled with all her might, making loud, yet cute grunts against Maiara’s sticky wet hands, trying to reach for one of the tennis-ball-sized rakujas. “NO! LEAVE THEM ALONE!” As the struggle kept going, Nina saw one last way to defend her precious children, and jabbed the fork side of a picker deep into Maiara’s arm.
2a146f387e5b.t: Nina, merasakan niat Maiara, berdiri, dan membongkok di atas meja, melindungi rakujanya dengan tangannya seperti ibu ayam melindungi anak-anaknya dari hujan. Namun, sia-sia sahaja kerana tangan Maiara dengan tegas mencapai rakujanya. “JANGAN! MAIARA! JANGAN!” Nina bergelut sekuat tenaga, mengeluarkan rengusan yang kuat namun comel melawan tangan Maiara yang melekit basah, yang cuba mencapai salah satu rakuja sebesar bola tenis. “JANGAN! JANGAN KACAU MEREKA!” Ketika pergelutan berterusan, Nina melihat satu cara terakhir untuk mempertahankan anak-anaknya yang berharga, dan menikam bahagian garpu sebatang picker jauh ke dalam lengan Maiara.

2c131abc7382.en: With a teasing laugh, the maid pushed Harry away. “Sora—you dummy!” She leaned forward, and poured the hot blackish tea into the two white porcelain cups she had brought. The tea itself had a rather thick, sandy sloppy consistency to it, just like the bottom of a muddy river. The steam coming out had a strong tangy, citrusy fragrance with sweet grass notes—not far from resembling an air refresher. She served a cup to Harry, then grabbed another one for herself, leaning back on the couch.
2c131abc7382.t: Dengan ketawa mengusik, pembantu rumah itu menolak Harry. “Sora la—bodoh!” Dia membongkok ke depan, dan menuang teh kehitaman yang panas ke dalam dua cawan porselin putih yang dibawanya. Teh itu sendiri mempunyai kepekatan yang agak tebal, berpasir dan selekeh, sama seperti dasar sungai berlumpur. Wap yang keluar mempunyai aroma masam dan sitrus yang kuat dengan nota rumput manis—tidak jauh berbeza dengan penyegar udara. Dia menghidangkan secawan kepada Harry, kemudian mengambil satu lagi untuk dirinya, bersandar di sofa.

2c1a2688aec3.en: The maid tapped her finger on the map, showing a bird’s-eye view of an inland harbor region with a large, roundish estuary in the middle where a sprawling city surrounded the inland-most part of the estuary. From those spread-out outports, large roads from near the ends headed inland, all merging in a triangle shape far inland. From that inland triangle vertice, an even larger road arose from the edge of the city, and went off the map to the west. She tapped her fingers at the eastern section of the city, near the east vertice of the triangle, close to the ports, where a small road randomly went to the right. “Are you from the Sanbi East slum?”
2c1a2688aec3.t: Pembantu rumah itu mengetuk jarinya pada peta, menunjukkan pandangan mata burung sebuah kawasan pelabuhan pedalaman dengan muara besar yang agak bulat di tengah di mana sebuah kota luas mengelilingi bahagian paling dalam muara itu. Dari pelabuhan-pelabuhan luar yang tersebar itu, jalan-jalan besar dari berhampiran hujungnya menuju ke pedalaman, semuanya bercantum dalam bentuk segi tiga jauh di pedalaman. Dari bucu segi tiga pedalaman itu, satu jalan yang lebih besar muncul dari pinggir kota, dan keluar dari peta ke barat. Dia mengetuk jarinya pada bahagian timur kota, berhampiran bucu timur segi tiga itu, dekat dengan pelabuhan, di mana satu jalan kecil secara rawak membelok ke kanan. “Kau dari setinggan Sanbi East ke?”

2c4d1bd0711c.en: “I—I—don’t know. Everything feels murky—I looked through a few books, but none of the drawings feels familiar!” Harry slouched his posture, his drooly eyes looked as if had finally given up.
2c4d1bd0711c.t: “Sa—sa—saya tak tahu. Semuanya terasa kelam—saya dah tengok beberapa buku, tapi tak ada satu pun lukisan yang terasa biasa!” Harry membongkokkan badannya, matanya yang layu kelihatan seolah-olah akhirnya sudah berputus asa.

2c9958c702f2.en: “—still not as good as Yacamim!” A mischievous low voice came from the princess in purple, Eori, as she slowly took another bite of her food, appearing to imitate Neferteri’s grace, but somehow looking more forced than natural. Normally the voice would go unheard, but the momentary silence in the room allowed it to propagate further than normal.
2c9958c702f2.t: “—masih tak sebagus Yacamim!” Suara rendah yang nakal datang dari puteri berambut ungu, Eori, ketika dia perlahan-lahan menggigit lagi makanannya, kelihatan meniru keanggunan Neferteri, tetapi entah bagaimana kelihatan lebih dipaksa daripada semula jadi. Biasanya suara itu tidak akan didengari, tetapi kesunyian seketika dalam bilik itu membolehkannya merebak lebih jauh daripada biasa.

2ed734a739ff.en: “I’m aware of your actions, please cease them.” Neferteri placed her wine glass on the table, and looked at Eori, enjoying herself with a large smirk from ear to ear despite her red swollen cheek, and still cleaning away rakuja seeds from her long purple hair.
2ed734a739ff.t: “Saya sedar akan tindakan kamu, sila hentikannya.” Neferteri meletakkan gelas wainnya di atas meja, dan memandang Eori, yang sedang menikmati dirinya dengan senyum sinis lebar dari telinga ke telinga walaupun pipinya merah dan bengkak, dan masih membersihkan biji rakuja dari rambut ungu panjangnya.

2f1cc8ac9d72.en: “Really? Then if you don’t mind my curiosity—how do you know what an hour is?” Arukia pressed her boobs further against Harry as she came closer.
2f1cc8ac9d72.t: “Ye ke? Kalau macam tu, kalau kau tak kisah aku ingin tahu—macam mana kau tahu apa itu jam?” Arukia menekan buah dadanya lebih kuat pada Harry ketika dia semakin dekat.

302ba0e4a485.en: “You two are paying for her rakujas,” Itagiba’s fatherly, but iron-strong willed voice sliced through Nina’s cries towards both princesses, pointing at them with a half-eaten purple meat thigh as if it was his gavel.
302ba0e4a485.t: “Korang berdua kena bayar rakuja dia,” suara kebapaan Itagiba yang berkemahuan sekuat besi menghiris tangisan Nina ke arah kedua-dua puteri, menunjuk ke arah mereka dengan peha daging ungu yang separuh dimakan seolah-olah itu tukul hakimnya.

338589b1f56d.en: Meanwhile, with a quick gulp to clear his throat, Harry pointed at the closed door where his eyes saw someone familiar. “I think it was her! The maid that gave me tea earlier in the day.”
338589b1f56d.t: Sementara itu, dengan telanan pantas untuk melegakan kerongkongnya, Harry menunjuk ke arah pintu yang tertutup di mana matanya nampak seseorang yang dikenali. “Saya rasa dia! Pembantu rumah yang bagi saya teh siang tadi.”

354a9090763d.en: Taking a long, slow sip of her muddy tea, Arukia’s cyan eyes narrowed towards Harry, taking umbrage as she watched his hesitancy to drink. Shuffling her hair like she didn’t care, Arukia followed up, “Maybe it was unrelated—anyway, now drink it up!”
354a9090763d.t: Menghirup teh berlumpurnya dengan panjang dan perlahan, mata biru kehijauan Arukia mengecil ke arah Harry, tersinggung melihat keraguannya untuk minum. Mengusutkan rambutnya seperti tidak peduli, Arukia menyusul, “Mungkin tak berkaitan—apa-apa pun, sekarang minum sampai habis!”

354fedb55edb.en: Harry, glancing through the contract, saw many unrecognizable words with what appeared to be a flowery language. Some words popped out like Gandew Common Duel Rights & Duties and Forway Duel “I—guess so—can you summarize it, please?”
354fedb55edb.t: Harry, mengerling kontrak itu, nampak banyak perkataan yang tidak dikenali dengan bahasa yang kelihatan berbunga-bunga. Beberapa perkataan menonjol seperti Gandew Common Duel Rights & Duties dan Forway Duel “Sa—saya rasa—boleh awak ringkaskan, tolong?”

357c9df48ec6.en: With a repressed groan, Harry felt repulsed from seeing how much tea was left—like a child seeing he still needs to eat all his veggies. “Hmmm—but another maid brought tea already. Do I have to drink more?”
357c9df48ec6.t: Dengan erangan yang ditahan, Harry merasa jijik melihat betapa banyak teh yang masih tinggal—seperti kanak-kanak yang melihat dia masih perlu menghabiskan semua sayurnya. “Hmmm—tapi pembantu rumah lain dah bawa teh. Kena minum lagi ke?”

370ec4a519b3.en: Sora was waking the big black bird up, calling it towards the table. “Y–yes! King-maid! Salted Bagarisa, marinated for half timehunk in butter, salt, nica pepper, and Yabuca juice, slow cooked for two timehunks, then flash fried at the end.” The cutesy small maid, blushing as always, flawlessly recited the recipe as she brought a plate closer for the bird to peck at.
370ec4a519b3.t: Sora sedang mengejutkan burung hitam besar itu, memanggilnya ke arah meja. “Y–ya! King-maid! Bagarisa masin, diperap selama separuh timehunk dalam mentega, garam, lada nica, dan jus Yabuca, dimasak perlahan selama dua timehunk, kemudian digoreng cepat di hujungnya.” Pembantu rumah kecil yang comel itu, merah padam seperti biasa, membacakan resipi itu dengan sempurna sambil mendekatkan sepinggan untuk burung itu mematuk.

375800e81fb1.en: “This is too fishy! Next time I will make it myself with gyut and bacon!” Arukia handed over the mostly intact bagel to Harry.
375800e81fb1.t: “Ni terlalu hanyir! Lain kali aku buat sendiri dengan gyut dan bakon!” Arukia menghulurkan bagel yang hampir tidak terusik itu kepada Harry.

38ef854c4b7d.en: “MOOOOM! My rakuja—” Nina’s voice cracked, and tears poured again from her eyes. She stood there in her seat, as if she had lost her babies.
38ef854c4b7d.t: “MAMAAA! Rakuja Nina—” Suara Nina pecah, dan air mata mencurah lagi dari matanya. Dia berdiri di tempat duduknya, seolah-olah dia kehilangan bayi-bayinya.

395090e71198.en: With a long-winded sigh, Harry walked back towards the southeast tower. Am I doing the right thing? Maybe I should have signed it already. I mean, after all, they gave me everything I have right now. But then why did Eiri say all of that? How can I even think carefully when I know jack shit?
395090e71198.t: Dengan keluhan panjang, Harry berjalan kembali ke arah menara tenggara. Betul ke apa yang aku buat ni? Mungkin aku patut dah tandatangan. Maksud aku, lagipun, mereka dah bagi aku semua yang aku ada sekarang. Tapi kenapa Eiri cakap semua tu? Macam mana aku nak fikir baik-baik kalau aku tak tahu apa-apa langsung?

3a079d059f53.en: Itagiba pointed to a half-eaten purple thigh towards Eori “True dat, but you poked her first, so that’s why you’re paying back half of what she gave to Nina.”
3a079d059f53.t: Itagiba menghalakan peha ungu yang separuh dimakan ke arah Eori “Betul tu, tapi kau yang cucuk dia dulu, sebab tu kau kena bayar balik separuh daripada apa yang dia bagi pada Nina.”

3a407e5425b1.en: “Itanema, can you go with her?” Eiri looked at the tall maid, just chilling, waiting for instructions as she didn’t seem to care whatever was happening.
3a407e5425b1.t: “Itanema, boleh kau ikut dia?” Eiri memandang pembantu rumah tinggi itu, yang sekadar bersantai, menunggu arahan kerana dia nampaknya tidak peduli apa sahaja yang berlaku.

3addbb915aea.en: Chapter IV subchapter 1: a brown-haired woman in a dark corset dress holding a teapot, smirking in a dim stairwell.
3addbb915aea.t: Bab IV subbab 1: seorang wanita berambut coklat dalam gaun korset gelap memegang teko, tersenyum sinis di tangga yang malap.

3c9c0064c018.en: “Ahh. I think the sausage. It was really good, but the meat was good too. Did you prepare it with mushrooms?” Harry pointed at the mostly empty plate right by the mess of rakujas left by Nina.
3c9c0064c018.t: “Ahh. Rasanya sosej tu. Sedap betul, tapi daging tu pun sedap. Awak masak dengan cendawan ke?” Harry menunjuk ke pinggan yang hampir kosong betul-betul di sebelah sepah rakuja yang ditinggalkan Nina.

3eb7ed866c80.en: Harry could feel her breath, her warmth, and the softness of her breasts still teasing him to no end. Unable to muster a complete sentence, all he could do was to mumble “Yeah—”
3eb7ed866c80.t: Harry dapat merasakan nafasnya, kehangatannya, dan kelembutan buah dadanya yang masih tidak henti-henti mengusiknya. Tidak mampu menyusun ayat yang lengkap, yang mampu dia lakukan hanyalah bergumam “Ha—”

3f9cfa1b355e.en: Itagiba whispered, or rather tried to whisper, but he was still quite loud. Saliva flew towards Harry’s ear, landing on his cheeks, “Don’t worry, bud! Hic—tonight I will try again! If a son comes out, I will make sure you will have the first dibs when he’s ready!” Itagiba mischievous snarked, then slapped Harry’s back three times, quite hard, appearing to save Harry from a non-existent choking hazard.
3f9cfa1b355e.t: Itagiba berbisik, atau lebih tepat cuba berbisik, tetapi masih agak kuat. Air liur terpercik ke telinga Harry, mendarat di pipinya, “Jangan risau, bro! Hik—malam ni aku cuba lagi! Kalau anak lelaki keluar, aku pastikan kau dapat tempahan pertama bila dia dah sedia!” Itagiba menyindir nakal, kemudian menampar belakang Harry tiga kali, agak kuat, seolah-olah menyelamatkan Harry daripada bahaya tercekik yang tidak wujud.

3fffac2c40bd.en: Neferteri was about to speak when a wet gurgle came from Itagiba, accompanied by an audible clap of a wooden mug hitting the table “It’s easy, bud! Hic! You sign the contract, and will duel Maiara tomorrow. If you win, you get her hand, and a life of riches—arrggghhh.” A wet burp came out of him. He held his mouth with a fist while the other hand gave a wait signal. A few seconds later, he followed up “—but if you lose, you will work for us.” Itagiba drunkenly opened his hands wide and far from his body. “I—mean—C’MON. That’s a fucking win either way right there!” He grabbed his empty cup, and pointed at Harry. “Do you know how many people would be dying for this?”
3fffac2c40bd.t: Neferteri hendak bercakap apabila deguk basah datang dari Itagiba, diiringi bunyi tepukan kole kayu menghentam meja “Senang je, bro! Hik! Kau tandatangan kontrak, dan akan bertarung dengan Maiara esok. Kalau kau menang, kau dapat tangan dia, dan hidup mewah—arrggghhh.” Sendawa basah keluar daripadanya. Dia menekup mulutnya dengan penumbuk sementara tangan yang lagi satu memberi isyarat tunggu. Beberapa saat kemudian, dia menyusul “—tapi kalau kau kalah, kau akan kerja untuk kami.” Itagiba dengan mabuk membuka tangannya luas-luas jauh dari badannya. “Maksud—aku—ALAH. Itu menang celaka dua-dua jalan tu!” Dia mengambil cawannya yang kosong, dan menunjuk ke arah Harry. “Kau tahu berapa ramai orang yang sanggup mati untuk ni?”

40002e2ccde2.en: “Motherfucker!” In the struggle, Maiara managed to grab a rakuja, then stood up and quickly threw it like a professional pitcher—arching her arm, and all—against Eori’s head right as she was about to enjoyingly take another bite.
40002e2ccde2.t: “Bangsat!” Dalam pergelutan itu, Maiara berjaya merampas sebiji rakuja, kemudian berdiri dan cepat-cepat membalingnya seperti pembaling profesional—melengkungkan lengannya, semuanya—ke kepala Eori tepat ketika dia hendak menikmati gigitan seterusnya.

40968cbe98f8.en: “That’s what you get!” A low, but audible girly voice came from the corner end of the table, from a princess in purple hair called Eori, right as she took another bite of a decently sized chunk of coal-grilled fish.
40968cbe98f8.t: “Padan muka!” Suara gadis yang rendah tetapi kedengaran datang dari hujung sudut meja, daripada puteri berambut ungu bernama Eori, tepat ketika dia menggigit lagi seketul ikan bakar arang yang agak besar.

4124dd0fd228.en: “Whenever the nari gel is finished.” Neferteri opened her hand, and received the contract from Eiri, then displayed it towards Harry. “My husband, even with his savory choice of words, did correctly summarize it.” She shone the faintest smile in the corner of her mouth towards Eiri “—Is there anything else you would like to add?”
4124dd0fd228.t: “Apabila nari gel itu siap.” Neferteri membuka tangannya, dan menerima kontrak itu daripada Eiri, kemudian menunjukkannya kepada Harry. “Suami saya, walaupun dengan pilihan katanya yang enak, telah meringkaskannya dengan betul.” Dia memancarkan senyuman paling samar di sudut mulutnya ke arah Eiri “—Ada apa-apa lagi yang anda mahu tambah?”

444c65a4dd33.en: “Yes, king-maid.” The tall maid with long black hair and freckles by the name of Itanema grabbed the wet towels from a nearby basket, approached Harry, and handed it to him in a shoving motion.
444c65a4dd33.t: “Baik, king-maid.” Pembantu rumah tinggi berambut hitam panjang dan berjeragat bernama Itanema mengambil tuala basah dari bakul berdekatan, mendekati Harry, dan menghulurkannya dengan gerakan menolak.

46c897b14047.en: “I’m Arukia—” Arukia smiled, interrupting herself mid-sentence. “—and I’ve been told you're Harry Sanbi, right?”
46c897b14047.t: “Aku Arukia—” Arukia tersenyum, memotong dirinya sendiri di tengah ayat. “—dan aku diberitahu kau Harry Sanbi, betul?”

479d7d2b49fa.en: Okay? Harry chowed down the bagel quickly, and did as told.
479d7d2b49fa.t: Okey? Harry melahap bagel itu dengan cepat, dan menurut.

4a18f56bf39e.en: Picking at the food on his plate, Harry brought a piece of a purple meat sausage to his mouth. There was a burst of chicken flavor, specifically from dark meat mixed with bone marrow. The fat within the sausage balanced the other spices out to create this smooth meaty goodness palate. Kinda tastes like chicken, but there is something different. Was it always purple? Hmmm—what about this? Kinda tastes a bit gamey—a little tough too. Oh? Is that mushroom? Harry picked at another meat that looked like corned brisket. He smelled it, then took another bite. It is definitely kinda salty, a bit peppery too—but is the mushroom smell from the meat itself? Hmmm. Never had this before. Would be nice inside a taco—
4a18f56bf39e.t: Menguis makanan di pinggannya, Harry membawa sepotong sosej daging ungu ke mulutnya. Ada letupan rasa ayam, khususnya dari daging gelap bercampur sumsum tulang. Lemak di dalam sosej itu mengimbangi rempah-rempah lain untuk mencipta rasa daging yang licin dan enak. Rasa macam ayam sikit, tapi ada sesuatu yang lain. Memang ungu dari dulu ke? Hmmm—yang ni pula? Rasa hamis sikit—liat sikit juga. Oh? Itu cendawan ke? Harry menguis daging lain yang kelihatan seperti daging lembu kornet. Dia menghidunya, kemudian menggigit lagi. Memang masin sikit, berlada sikit juga—tapi bau cendawan tu dari daging tu sendiri ke? Hmmm. Tak pernah makan ni. Mesti sedap dalam taco—

4a83758199a9.en: With a sudden thirst for blood, Maiara’s hands searched the table for something, stopping to focus on the Rakujas.
4a83758199a9.t: Dengan dahaga darah yang tiba-tiba, tangan Maiara mencari-cari sesuatu di atas meja, berhenti untuk menumpukan perhatian pada Rakuja.

4b42bdb44c14.en: “Itanema!” Arukia angrily tried to call the maid at the door, but it was too late. She already closed it without giving a chance for rebuttal.
4b42bdb44c14.t: “Itanema!” Arukia cuba memanggil pembantu rumah di pintu itu dengan marah, tetapi sudah terlambat. Dia sudah menutupnya tanpa memberi peluang untuk membalas.

4cb40f1ff415.en: The maid grabbed an open book from atop the couch, and sat in its place with no finesse, or femininity, at all. Adjusting her hair, she crossed her legs, locking away her jewel box from potential prying male fingers and eyes.
4cb40f1ff415.t: Pembantu rumah itu mengambil sebuah buku yang terbuka dari atas sofa, dan duduk di tempatnya tanpa kehalusan, atau kewanitaan, langsung. Membetulkan rambutnya, dia menyilangkan kakinya, mengunci kotak permatanya daripada jari dan mata lelaki yang mungkin mengintip.

4cf49203bba0.en: Neferteri, the queen, beside Itagiba, lost her elegant smile and restful expression. In its place, arose a stare like daggers against Nina. “No more rakujas until next Sannday.”
4cf49203bba0.t: Neferteri, permaisuri, di sebelah Itagiba, hilang senyuman anggun dan riak tenangnya. Di tempatnya, timbul renungan seperti belati terhadap Nina. “Tiada lagi rakuja sehingga Sannday depan.”

4e215938a4eb.en: “What? I didn’t say anything!” Eori took another bite of her food, and lifted a towel to hide her mouth—trying to hide a wide grin based on the wrinkle in her eyes.
4e215938a4eb.t: “Apa? Saya tak cakap apa-apa pun!” Eori menggigit lagi makanannya, dan mengangkat tuala untuk menyembunyikan mulutnya—cuba menyembunyikan sengihan lebar berdasarkan kedutan di matanya.

4f8d812bf6e3.en: Placing her open hand towards the contract, Neferteri broke the silence. “I will give you until Monnahigh to consider this proposition. If you do not wish to sign, then the guards will escort you back to the slums. King-maid?” Her voice was just as strong-willed, but far more stern than her husband’s.
4f8d812bf6e3.t: Meletakkan tangannya yang terbuka ke arah kontrak, Neferteri memecah kesunyian. “Saya akan memberi kamu masa sehingga Monnahigh untuk mempertimbangkan cadangan ini. Jika kamu tidak mahu menandatangan, maka pengawal akan mengiringi kamu kembali ke kawasan setinggan. King-maid?” Suaranya sama teguh, tetapi jauh lebih tegas daripada suaminya.

50778a550538.en: Still having no words, Harry cleaned Itagiba’s saliva from his ear as he saw the king happily stumble his way out of the room.
50778a550538.t: Masih tiada kata-kata, Harry membersihkan air liur Itagiba dari telinganya sambil melihat raja itu terhuyung-hayang dengan gembira keluar dari bilik.

5424eaf205af.t: “Baik, king-maid,” pembantu rumah itu meminta diri.

553cc4877ed8.en: Standing up as well, Harry felt an idea snap through his brain “Wait. Why can’t I take the contract with me to my room?”
553cc4877ed8.t: Turut berdiri, Harry merasakan satu idea menyentak otaknya “Kejap. Kenapa saya tak boleh bawa kontrak tu ke bilik saya?”

55cbdce0cf31.en: “Shesh—I didn’t tell you to gulp it down.” The maid took Harry’s empty cup.
55cbdce0cf31.t: “Isy—aku tak suruh kau teguk sekali gus.” Pembantu rumah itu mengambil cawan kosong Harry.

56d45e39e44e.en: A tall maid with black hair and freckles opened a sliver of the door. “Harry—oh Arukia. Since you’re here glued to him, clean it up, and bring him down for dinner.” Her monotone voice sounded like it was her final words. “—Unless you want Maiara to find out.”
56d45e39e44e.t: Seorang pembantu rumah tinggi berambut hitam dan berjeragat membuka sedikit pintu. “Harry—oh Arukia. Alang-alang kau dah melekat kat dia, kemaskan semua ni, dan bawa dia turun untuk makan malam.” Suaranya yang mendatar kedengaran seperti kata-kata terakhirnya. “—Kecuali kau nak Maiara tahu.”

594df77f5f5c.en: Neferteri brought out her badge, and handed it over to Eiri. Eiri, in turn, placed the badge on top of the splattered blood, making the base of the thermometer-like apparatus, where one would put his or her thumb, faintly glow.
594df77f5f5c.t: Neferteri mengeluarkan lencananya, dan menyerahkannya kepada Eiri. Eiri, seterusnya, meletakkan lencana itu di atas percikan darah, membuatkan pangkal alat seperti termometer itu, tempat seseorang meletakkan ibu jarinya, bersinar samar.

59ff13389195.en: “I visited the Forway castle once, nothing out of this world—it’s just a large black tower with a bunch of self-important people. But who cares about them?” The maid quickly flipped through several pages, stopping on a bird’s eye view of a specific map. “I'd rather know about my special guest!” The maid squished her breasts against Harry’s arm, placing the open book in his lap.
59ff13389195.t: “Aku pernah melawat istana Forway sekali, tak ada yang luar biasa pun—cuma menara hitam besar dengan sekumpulan orang yang bangga diri. Tapi siapa peduli pasal mereka?” Pembantu rumah itu cepat-cepat menyelak beberapa halaman, berhenti pada pandangan mata burung sebuah peta tertentu. “Aku lebih suka tahu pasal tetamu istimewa aku!” Pembantu rumah itu menekan buah dadanya pada lengan Harry, meletakkan buku yang terbuka itu di ribanya.

5ab2759d9b43.en: “You think? That’s—” A snappy, yet girly response ensued, but Arukia seemed to catch herself with a breath. Changing back to a more persuasive tone, she continued. “Is that because Nina gave you that name?”
5ab2759d9b43.t: “Rasanya? Itu—” Jawapan yang pantas namun keanak-gadisan menyusul, tetapi Arukia nampaknya menahan dirinya dengan satu nafas. Bertukar kembali ke nada yang lebih memujuk, dia menyambung. “Sebab Nina yang bagi kau nama tu ke?”

5cf340fcd1b8.en: “We will talk later. Now apologize to him, and clean your hands.” Neferteri took a small bite of her food.
5cf340fcd1b8.t: “Kita bincang nanti. Sekarang minta maaf kepadanya, dan bersihkan tangan kamu.” Neferteri menyuap sedikit makanannya.

5ea8e2a4ca8b.en: The sound of Nefeteri’s footing echoed in the dining hall, while Harry and Eiri stood in silence, looking at one another.
5ea8e2a4ca8b.t: Bunyi langkah Nefeteri bergema di dewan makan, sementara Harry dan Eiri berdiri dalam diam, berpandangan antara satu sama lain.

60bc79b4d68f.en: “Thank you, princess Nina—” The queen took a small glance at Harry and Nina as the elegance of her expression remained.
60bc79b4d68f.t: “Terima kasih, puteri Nina—” Permaisuri mengerling sekilas ke arah Harry dan Nina sementara keanggunan riaknya kekal.

622e677c9eca.en: “HARRY! RAKUJA!” A sweet, energetic child’s voice echoed above the normal murmurs at the dinner table.
622e677c9eca.t: “HARRY! RAKUJA!” Suara kanak-kanak yang manis dan bertenaga bergema mengatasi gumaman biasa di meja makan.

626b830bde1d.en: Removing the picker with a swift pull, Maiara responded to Itagiba by throwing it on the table towards Nina. With her arm now bleeding profusely from what appeared to be a snake bite, she stained her own clothes, and the floor, as she took out a small sack from inside her leather garment, and threw it across the table, right on Nina’s rakuja plate, making a metallic, rocky sound as it struck. “Take your fucking rakujas then—” Maiara made her way out of the dining room, stomping out as she held her profusely bleeding arm, leaving a trail of dripped blood in the floor.
626b830bde1d.t: Mencabut picker dengan sentapan pantas, Maiara membalas Itagiba dengan mencampakkannya ke atas meja ke arah Nina. Dengan lengannya kini berdarah banyak dari sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti gigitan ular, dia mengotorkan pakaiannya sendiri, dan lantai, sambil mengeluarkan karung kecil dari dalam pakaian kulitnya, dan mencampakkannya ke seberang meja, betul-betul ke atas pinggan rakuja Nina, mengeluarkan bunyi logam berbatu ketika ia mendarat. “Ambillah rakuja celaka kau tu—” Maiara keluar dari dewan makan, menghentak kaki sambil memegang lengannya yang berdarah banyak, meninggalkan jejak darah yang menitis di lantai.

627cd84d66d4.en: Harry saw a plethora of purple meat fibers stuck in the teeth of this towering man. Next, a strong beer breath came out as he further approached, looking as if the king was about to kiss him on the cheeks. Harry stood there, still paralyzed, with a shock to his face as if he was about to be shot. Meanwhile, his hands clenched tightly against his body, failing to even try to defend himself.
627cd84d66d4.t: Harry nampak lambakan serat daging ungu tersekat di gigi lelaki tinggi ini. Kemudian, nafas bir yang kuat keluar ketika dia semakin mendekat, kelihatan seolah-olah raja itu hendak mencium pipinya. Harry kaku di situ, masih lumpuh, dengan riak terkejut di wajahnya seolah-olah dia hendak ditembak. Sementara itu, tangannya mengepal rapat ke badannya, gagal walaupun untuk cuba mempertahankan diri.

63d0361c48d8.en: Itagiba, the king dressed in gold with blue fish scales, belly laughed, but quickly choked on his half eaten meat, and had to resort to gulping it down with beer.
63d0361c48d8.t: Itagiba, raja yang berpakaian emas dengan sisik ikan biru, ketawa terbahak-bahak, tetapi cepat-cepat tercekik daging yang separuh dimakannya, dan terpaksa meneguknya dengan bir.

67c055b25c9d.en: “I’m sorry, Harry. You need to make the call, not me—that’s all I can do right now. If you really want to read it, then go across the hall and knock on the monarchy department. That’s where Neferteri probably went, but be wary of her—” With an anguished look, Eiri moved her hand towards the door, telling Harry to move on.
67c055b25c9d.t: “Maaf, Harry. Kau yang kena buat keputusan, bukan aku—itu je yang aku boleh buat sekarang. Kalau kau betul-betul nak baca, pergi ke seberang dewan dan ketuk pintu jabatan monarki. Situlah mungkin Neferteri pergi, tapi berhati-hati dengan dia—” Dengan riak resah, Eiri menggerakkan tangannya ke arah pintu, menyuruh Harry beredar.

6c3a94bccec7.en: With his elbows on the table, Harry slowly rubbed one palm on the back of the other hand, looking back at the contract, “Thank you—it’s just that I—need some time. I want to read it carefully, but—”
6c3a94bccec7.t: Dengan siku di atas meja, Harry perlahan-lahan menggosok sebelah tapak tangan pada belakang tangan yang lagi satu, memandang semula kontrak itu, “Terima kasih—cuma saya—perlukan masa. Saya nak baca betul-betul, tapi—”

6cd859eaefe5.en: “Don’t give me that look!” The maid snapped at Harry, taking a shallow sip of her own tea, somehow enjoying its complex flavors.
6cd859eaefe5.t: “Jangan bagi aku muka macam tu!” Pembantu rumah itu menyergah Harry, menghirup sedikit tehnya sendiri, entah bagaimana menikmati rasanya yang kompleks.

72334f4ab7f7.en: “Ahhh—no?” Harry felt his heart rate pound on the back of his throat. Moving his hand close to his body, Harry held them tightly, away from the towering drunk king on the other side of the table.
72334f4ab7f7.t: “Ahhh—tak?” Harry merasakan degupan jantungnya berdebar di belakang kerongkongnya. Menggerakkan tangannya rapat ke badan, Harry memegangnya erat-erat, jauh dari raja mabuk yang tinggi lampai di seberang meja.
