766d291b63ce.en: “Cease for what? She’s the one throwing rakujas around like a maniac!” Eori's voice sounded like she had her cheek full of food—like a squirrel prepping for winter.
766d291b63ce.t: “Hentikan apa? Dia yang baling rakuja macam orang gila!” Suara Eori kedengaran seperti pipinya penuh dengan makanan—seperti tupai bersiap untuk musim sejuk.

7679fdb24d6a.en: Biting her lips with a grin, Arukia followed with a sensual tone as she poked her finger on Harry’s cheek. “You could say I heard about it before—”
7679fdb24d6a.t: Menggigit bibirnya sambil tersengih, Arukia menyusul dengan nada sensual sambil mencucuk jarinya pada pipi Harry. “Boleh kata aku pernah dengar sebelum ni—”

79449fae6bf1.en: Harry felt the softness of her breasts teasing him, while her perfume, with notes of bubblegum mixed with grapes, softly tickled his nose.
79449fae6bf1.t: Harry merasakan kelembutan buah dadanya mengusiknya, sementara minyak wanginya, dengan aroma gula-gula getah bercampur anggur, menggeletek hidungnya dengan lembut.

799812daf0ee.en: “—Maiara?” Harry's vision of a princess like Eori, maybe sexier like Arukia, or cuter like Sora all crumbled in front of his eyes. In the shattered expectations, he felt his heart sinking.
799812daf0ee.t: “—Maiara?” Bayangan Harry tentang seorang puteri seperti Eori, mungkin lebih seksi seperti Arukia, atau lebih comel seperti Sora semuanya runtuh di depan matanya. Dalam harapan yang berkecai, dia merasakan jantungnya tenggelam.

79e469291f09.en: “MOM! MY RAKUJA!” Nina pointed towards Maiara with the picker in her hand. Her mouth slacking, she openly stared at what Maiara was about to do as if someone was about to crush her own soul—
79e469291f09.t: “MAMA! RAKUJA NINA!” Nina menunjuk ke arah Maiara dengan picker di tangannya. Mulutnya ternganga, dia merenung terang-terangan apa yang Maiara hendak lakukan seolah-olah seseorang hendak menghancurkan jiwanya sendiri—

7a4ff3f90f95.en: “Courtroom scientist Kibe! Do you want the rest of your dinner delivered to your room?” a higher pitched, fast hip hop speech came out of Sora.
7a4ff3f90f95.t: “Saintis istana Kibe! Tuan mahu baki makan malam tuan dihantar ke bilik tuan?” Ucapan hip hop yang laju dan bernada tinggi keluar daripada Sora.

7bdf346039e2.en: “No? But you reminded me a bit of some Toleridemians I knew—but you have no memories from there, or from Sanbi—even the slums. Sora told me about you. She wants to help you too, but she doesn’t know how—but I do! So, tell me anything you know! I promise I won’t tell anyone else.” She slowly blinked, caressing Harry with her hand.
7bdf346039e2.t: “Tak? Tapi kau ingatkan aku sikit pada beberapa orang Tolerideme yang aku kenal—tapi kau tak ada ingatan dari sana, atau dari Sanbi—setinggan pun tak ada. Sora dah cerita pasal kau. Dia nak tolong kau juga, tapi dia tak tahu macam mana—tapi aku tahu! Jadi, bagi tahu aku apa saja yang kau tahu! Aku janji aku tak bagi tahu orang lain.” Dia berkelip perlahan, membelai Harry dengan tangannya.

7ecfedbf82c1.en: Looking at the half-empty solo cup of tea, and mostly empty jug by the coffee table, the maid let out an audible “tsk” with her tongue. She placed down her cup, and picked that one up to take a whiff. “There's not even Black Honey here! Who gave this to you?”
7ecfedbf82c1.t: Memandang cawan teh tunggal yang tinggal separuh, dan jag yang hampir kosong di tepi meja kopi, pembantu rumah itu mendecit “cis” yang kedengaran dengan lidahnya. Dia meletakkan cawannya, dan mengambil cawan itu untuk menghidunya. “Madu Hitam pun tak ada kat sini! Siapa yang bagi kau ni?”

7fbf5b012982.en: Grabbing everyone’s attention, neutering the chuckle with the looks of someone down to get business done, Neferteri followed up with a clear of her throat. “As I was saying, we will be giving you nari gels to improve your eyesight. Shall we go to the office to sign?”
7fbf5b012982.t: Menarik perhatian semua orang, meneutralkan ketawa kecil itu dengan rupa seseorang yang bersedia untuk menyelesaikan urusan, Neferteri menyusul dengan berdehem. “Seperti yang saya katakan, kami akan memberikan kamu nari gel untuk memperbaiki penglihatan kamu. Bolehkah kita ke pejabat untuk menandatangan?”

8545b315eead.en: “No—thank you.” Harry felt a grandmotherly vibe as he handed the towel back to her. Soon after, he saw another maid come in—one with a familiar face, and name: Arukia. Her sensual hips walking past him still stoked something primal inside him. However, she did not even make eye contact, or acknowledge him, let alone speak a word.
8545b315eead.t: “Tak—terima kasih.” Harry merasakan getaran seorang nenek ketika dia memulangkan tuala itu kepadanya. Tidak lama kemudian, dia melihat seorang lagi pembantu rumah masuk—yang berwajah dan bernama biasa: Arukia. Pinggulnya yang sensual berjalan melepasinya masih membangkitkan sesuatu yang purba dalam dirinya. Namun, dia langsung tidak bertentang mata, atau mengakui kehadirannya, apatah lagi bercakap sepatah pun.

86707b87b4aa.en: “Yes, king—argh—maid!” Sora’s voice echoed back, but this time strained. Itagiba’s near audible grunts also came in—it sounded like they were having sumo wrestling.
86707b87b4aa.t: “Baik, king—argh—maid!” Suara Sora bergema kembali, tetapi kali ini tegang. Rengusan Itagiba yang hampir kedengaran juga masuk—bunyinya seperti mereka sedang bergusti sumo.

89a9ecfdb8d7.en: The alluring smile on the maid’s red lips quickly waned to a frown and a pout. “You're gonna stare at my rack all day or what? I’m carrying stuff.” A cutesy female voice slipped out of her, but the words within stinged like a wasp’s. Her hands held a jug and a blue basket with brown paper bags poking through the open top.
89a9ecfdb8d7.t: Senyuman memikat di bibir merah pembantu rumah itu cepat-cepat pudar menjadi kerutan dan muncung. “Kau nak renung dada aku sepanjang hari ke apa? Aku tengah angkat barang ni.” Suara wanita yang comel terlepas daripadanya, tetapi kata-kata di dalamnya menyengat seperti tebuan. Tangannya memegang sebuah jag dan bakul biru dengan beg kertas coklat terjengul dari bahagian atasnya yang terbuka.

8d785e2f720d.en: Harry, finishing wiping his face and parts of his hair, opened his reddened blurry eyes towards her, taken aback by the coarseness unexpectedly coming out of someone who didn’t look like they would say such a thing. Her long dark purple hair with blue strands, held into a large ponytail, was tied by a red and pink butterfly hair tie. Her gentle purple eyes and fair skin made her pretty to look at, but with a few more blinks one could see clear hints of Itagiba’s characteristics, especially when she started speaking.
8d785e2f720d.t: Harry, selesai mengesat mukanya dan sebahagian rambutnya, membuka matanya yang merah dan kabur ke arahnya, terkejut dengan kekasaran yang tidak dijangka datang dari seseorang yang tidak kelihatan seperti akan berkata begitu. Rambut ungu gelapnya yang panjang dengan helaian biru, diikat menjadi ekor kuda besar, diikat dengan pengikat rambut rama-rama merah dan merah jambu. Mata ungunya yang lembut dan kulitnya yang cerah membuatkannya cantik dipandang, tetapi dengan beberapa kelipan lagi orang dapat melihat petunjuk jelas ciri-ciri Itagiba, terutamanya apabila dia mula bercakap.

8da2958e6470.en: “WHAT?” Pure sadness coursed through Nina's teary eyes as she stared back at her mother, using her grubby little hands to pull on her arm. “WHY, MOMMA?”
8da2958e6470.t: “APA?” Kesedihan tulen mengalir di mata Nina yang berair ketika dia merenung balik ibunya, menggunakan tangan kecilnya yang comot untuk menarik lengannya. “KENAPA, MAMA?”

90385b13689b.en: Harry’s slight smile disappeared as his eyes watched over the contract, with Neferteri’s badge still glowing faintly at her own blood signature.
90385b13689b.t: Senyuman kecil Harry hilang ketika matanya memerhati kontrak itu, dengan lencana Neferteri masih bersinar samar pada tandatangan darahnya sendiri.

9132d3657ead.en: “Is that how you planned to introduce yourself—dear princess Maiara?” Neferteri softly, and elegantly remarked without looking at the pony-tailed princess. She instead took another small bite of her food, oozing elegance with her pinky finger raised, and careful and calculated demeanor as if she was from the Victorian times.
9132d3657ead.t: “Begitukah cara kamu merancang untuk memperkenalkan diri—puteri Maiara yang dikasihi?” Neferteri berkata dengan lembut dan anggun tanpa memandang puteri berekor kuda itu. Sebaliknya dia menyuap sedikit lagi makanannya, memancarkan keanggunan dengan jari kelingking terangkat, dan gaya yang teliti dan berkira-kira seolah-olah dia dari zaman Victoria.

93b974a40fe5.en: “What do I do?” Harry spoke under his breath towards Eiri, but her eyes were carefully aimed towards the open door Neferteri just crossed.
93b974a40fe5.t: “Apa saya patut buat?” Harry bercakap perlahan kepada Eiri, tetapi matanya ditujukan dengan teliti ke arah pintu terbuka yang baru dilalui Neferteri.

954d8ddbebbf.en: A small hum came out of Harry, connecting the dots in his head. He looked at Eiri’s worrying eyes, seeking salvation.
954d8ddbebbf.t: Dengungan kecil keluar daripada Harry, menghubungkan titik-titik dalam kepalanya. Dia memandang mata Eiri yang risau, mencari penyelamatan.

97916cc5be11.en: Embarrassedly smiling back, Harry felt this odd aura coming from her—something akin to Arukia, but far more aggressive than playful. His hand held a picker with food, unsure whether to put it in his mouth, or place it back in the plate.
97916cc5be11.t: Tersenyum balik dengan malu, Harry merasakan aura aneh datang daripadanya—sesuatu seperti Arukia, tetapi jauh lebih agresif daripada suka bermain. Tangannya memegang picker dengan makanan, tidak pasti sama ada mahu memasukkannya ke mulut, atau meletakkannya semula ke pinggan.

9f8158736224.en: Sora ran out of the room as if she was running away from a building on fire, while everybody else remained acting as if nothing happened.
9f8158736224.t: Sora berlari keluar dari bilik seolah-olah dia melarikan diri dari bangunan yang terbakar, sementara semua orang lain terus berkelakuan seolah-olah tiada apa-apa yang berlaku.

a0aa886059b6.en: “That’s what a big fat pussy would say!” Itagiba moved his chair back with his feet, making a scratching noise on the floor. Standing up, he pointed the empty glass jug to himself “Hic. Maiara is my daughter! and I gave you permission to fuck her. Hic. What more do you fucking want? Ahhhhhhh—” Itagiba suddenly threw himself into a laughing fit. “Hol’ up! Do you like men instead? Is that what you are trying to holler?”
a0aa886059b6.t: “Itulah yang pondan gemuk akan cakap!” Itagiba menolak kerusinya ke belakang dengan kakinya, mengeluarkan bunyi menggaru di lantai. Berdiri, dia menghalakan jag kaca kosong itu ke dirinya “Hik. Maiara anak aku! dan aku dah bagi kau izin untuk main dengan dia. Hik. Apa lagi celaka yang kau nak? Ahhhhhhh—” Itagiba tiba-tiba ketawa tidak terkawal. “Kejap! Kau suka lelaki ke? Itu ke yang kau cuba nak cakap?”

a0da7a01ca46.en: Eiri stood up, still looking towards the door, she responded under her breath as well. “Just do what you think is best, I’m sorry—need help going back to your room?”
a0da7a01ca46.t: Eiri berdiri, masih memandang ke arah pintu, dia turut menjawab perlahan. “Buat je apa yang kau rasa terbaik, maaf—perlukan bantuan nak balik ke bilik?”

a1a0c7f50a5c.en: A loud burp came out of Itagiba. “—mushrooms? What’s that?” Itagiba poured another one for himself.
a1a0c7f50a5c.t: Sendawa kuat keluar daripada Itagiba. “—cendawan? Apa benda tu?” Itagiba menuang lagi untuk dirinya.

a24ba2a88b63.en: With a sweeping motion, Maiara grabbed one of the Rakujas away from Nina’s tiny slimy hands, right as she was about to perform an incision to extract the tangy goodness.
a24ba2a88b63.t: Dengan gerakan menyapu, Maiara merampas salah satu Rakuja dari tangan kecil Nina yang berlendir, tepat ketika dia hendak membuat torehan untuk mengeluarkan kebaikan masamnya.

a3b992f8c985.en: I just don’t get it. Itanema barely spoke to me earlier today, but then Arukia was really friendly—wait! Was she actually into me after all? SHIT! Maybe she was giving signs all along, and I just never realized? Harry mindlessly took a bite of his food even though he was already kinda feeling full. In his mind he pictured the moment Itagiba told him about marrying a princess. But—but I’m supposed to marry a princess! I actually completely forgot that! Harry looked towards Itagiba, finishing up eating a purple meat, discussing something about a new deal with Waterfall City amongst the other people at the table. I guess I am glad I did not do anything stupid after all—I just hope Maiara is as hot as Arukia, or at least as cute as Sora. Harry glanced at tiny Sora before checking outside for the quickly encroaching night, now being bathed in a sea of white lights amongst the buildings poking above the castle walls.
a3b992f8c985.t: Aku memang tak faham. Itanema hampir tak bercakap dengan aku siang tadi, tapi lepas tu Arukia betul-betul mesra—kejap! Dia memang suka aku ke sebenarnya? SIAL! Mungkin dia dah bagi isyarat dari tadi, dan aku je yang tak perasan? Harry tanpa berfikir menggigit makanannya walaupun dia sudah agak kenyang. Dalam fikirannya dia membayangkan saat Itagiba memberitahunya tentang berkahwin dengan seorang puteri. Tapi—tapi aku sepatutnya kahwin dengan puteri! Aku betul-betul lupa pasal tu! Harry memandang ke arah Itagiba, yang sedang menghabiskan daging ungu, membincangkan sesuatu tentang perjanjian baharu dengan Waterfall City di antara orang lain di meja itu. Rasanya aku lega juga aku tak buat benda bodoh—aku cuma harap Maiara sama hot macam Arukia, atau sekurang-kurangnya secomel Sora. Harry mengerling Sora yang kecil sebelum melihat ke luar ke arah malam yang cepat menjelma, kini bermandikan lautan cahaya putih di antara bangunan-bangunan yang menjengul di atas tembok istana.

a473984e6bd4.en: Holding his cramping stomach, Harry felt a violent urge to vomit as the tea ran down his esophagus and punched his gut, but as the seconds passed the urge dialed back, just enough for him to open his watery eyes to Arukia offering him her cup. Even though it had a red lipstick stain tantalizing him to drink it as well, his body shuddered in pure revolt.
a473984e6bd4.t: Memegang perutnya yang kejang, Harry merasakan desakan ganas untuk muntah ketika teh itu mengalir ke esofagusnya dan menumbuk perutnya, tetapi ketika detik berlalu desakan itu berkurangan, cukup untuk dia membuka matanya yang berair kepada Arukia yang menawarkan cawannya. Walaupun ada kesan gincu merah yang menggoda untuk diminum juga, tubuhnya menggigil dalam pemberontakan tulen.

a5e11a3e9852.en: With a deep breath, Harry went bottoms up on the cup, gulping it all down, while trying to ignore his tongue being waterboarded by this runny slope of muddy water.
a5e11a3e9852.t: Dengan tarikan nafas dalam, Harry meneguk habis cawan itu, menelannya semua, sambil cuba tidak mengendahkan lidahnya yang diseksa dengan air oleh aliran air berlumpur yang cair ini.

a6f44aeb3bcc.en: The maid entered the room as if she owned the place, with chin up, and hips swinging. Leaving Harry behind her, she headed towards a circular coffee table that stood between a greenish leathery couch and a few bookcases. Pushing a lone existing half-drunk cup, and a mostly empty jug aside, she slowly placed down her metal jug and a blue fish scale basket.
a6f44aeb3bcc.t: Pembantu rumah itu memasuki bilik seolah-olah dia pemilik tempat itu, dengan dagu terangkat, dan pinggul berlenggang. Meninggalkan Harry di belakangnya, dia menuju ke meja kopi bulat yang terletak di antara sofa kulit kehijauan dan beberapa rak buku. Menolak sebiji cawan yang tinggal separuh diminum, dan jag yang hampir kosong ke tepi, dia perlahan-lahan meletakkan jag logamnya dan bakul sisik ikan biru.

a71040062c66.en: “I understand where you are. I truly do,” Neferteri placed her hand on the table, making a soft chimney sound as the metallic golden rings in her hands clashed on it. “We do acknowledge you have eyesight issues. For that, I’ve requested a nari gel from Princess Eori—for she can make some gels just as good as veteran scientists. And do not worry, you do not need to partake in the contract for that benefit.” Neferteri made deep eye contact with Harry as the corners of her mouth formed a small smile. “Think of it as a token of our gratitude for indulging in our request. As soon as it is ready, a maid will deliver it to your room.”
a71040062c66.t: “Saya faham kedudukan kamu. Saya benar-benar faham,” Neferteri meletakkan tangannya di atas meja, mengeluarkan bunyi dentingan lembut ketika cincin-cincin emas logam di tangannya berlaga dengannya. “Kami memang mengakui kamu mempunyai masalah penglihatan. Untuk itu, saya telah meminta nari gel daripada Puteri Eori—kerana dia boleh membuat sesetengah gel sebaik saintis veteran. Dan jangan risau, kamu tidak perlu menyertai kontrak untuk manfaat itu.” Neferteri bertentang mata dalam-dalam dengan Harry sementara sudut mulutnya membentuk senyuman kecil. “Anggaplah ia tanda penghargaan kami kerana sudi melayan permintaan kami. Sebaik sahaja ia siap, seorang pembantu rumah akan menghantarnya ke bilik kamu.”

aba202a3a7a4.en: Nina, like the flip of a switch, stopped crying, and opened the sack. A sudden smile shone on her face, immediately jumping out of the chair, and taking off towards the door as well, only for them to slip on the trailing blood, and fall backwards, knocking her head. Instead of crying, she firmly stood up, with the leather bag still tightly held in hands, and charged towards the door—her pink uniform, and hair messy with blood.
aba202a3a7a4.t: Nina, seperti suis yang dipetik, berhenti menangis, dan membuka karung itu. Senyuman tiba-tiba bersinar di wajahnya, serta-merta melompat dari kerusi, dan berlari ke arah pintu juga, hanya untuk tergelincir pada jejak darah itu, dan jatuh terlentang, terhantuk kepalanya. Bukannya menangis, dia berdiri dengan tegas, dengan beg kulit itu masih digenggam erat di tangan, dan meluru ke pintu—seragam merah jambunya, dan rambutnya comot dengan darah.

b03f8935dc19.en: Unable to take action, Harry stared at the glow in Neferteri’s badge, devoid of thought as to what to do.
b03f8935dc19.t: Tidak mampu bertindak, Harry merenung cahaya pada lencana Neferteri, kosong tanpa fikiran tentang apa yang hendak dilakukan.

b0b63312ebec.en: “Yo! Wanna check out the contract now? It’s gonna be good!” Itagiba’s voice cheered, gulping down another beer.
b0b63312ebec.t: “Yo! Nak tengok kontrak sekarang? Mesti best!” Suara Itagiba bersorak, meneguk sebotol lagi bir.

b1041fcb8dc1.en: Like a rat smelling a trap, Harry felt a sense of doom, carefully grabbing a bagel out of her hands, and bringing it to his nose. He assumed an aggressive smell would slap his senses away, but this time a faint smell of recently baked bread infused with cream cheese and smoked salmon gently came through instead. Carefully taking a bite out of it, he prepared himself for the worst, but instead was presented with a pleasurable soft bread experience that cradled his tongue with gentle flavors from the spread, making him forget the previous flavor punch.
b1041fcb8dc1.t: Seperti tikus yang menghidu perangkap, Harry merasakan malapetaka, dengan berhati-hati mengambil sebiji bagel dari tangannya, dan mendekatkannya ke hidung. Dia menyangka bau yang garang akan menampar derianya, tetapi kali ini bau samar roti yang baru dibakar disertai keju krim dan salmon salai datang dengan lembut. Berhati-hati menggigitnya, dia bersedia untuk yang paling teruk, tetapi sebaliknya disajikan dengan pengalaman roti lembut yang menyenangkan yang membuai lidahnya dengan rasa lembut dari sapuan, membuatkannya lupa tumbukan rasa sebelumnya.

b2f4a894dd03.en: With a weak nod, Harry agreed as he remembered the whole monkey around thing Nina was doing.
b2f4a894dd03.t: Dengan anggukan lemah, Harry bersetuju sambil teringat semua terkinja-kinja yang Nina lakukan.

b4629429a2aa.en: Sora, with her hand reaching out, was about to speak when she got shut down. Her head dropped, and she flimsily played with her hands, reddening in the face.
b4629429a2aa.t: Sora, dengan tangannya terhulur, hendak bercakap apabila dia dipotong. Kepalanya tertunduk, dan dia bermain dengan tangannya dengan lemah, wajahnya memerah.

b5a185983608.en: Cursing under her own breath, Eori stood up, and walked away as well. “No—Sora, I do not want the rest of my dinner delivered to my room,” she said without looking back at Sora.
b5a185983608.t: Menyumpah perlahan, Eori berdiri, dan turut berjalan pergi. “Tak—Sora, saya tak mahu baki makan malam saya dihantar ke bilik saya,” katanya tanpa menoleh ke arah Sora.

b934370c8bd6.en: Neferteri waited a few seconds, letting the sound of steam coming from the large fost lamps hanging above them fester the room.
b934370c8bd6.t: Neferteri menunggu beberapa saat, membiarkan bunyi wap dari lampu fost besar yang tergantung di atas mereka memenuhi bilik itu.

ba22bc1938b0.en: The maid quickly flipped a few more pages, chewing her lips. Suddenly, her serious eyes focused on Harry. “Are you a new doorman, or what? Just close it already, and come sit down by me—” Letting out a sigh, she sized Harry up and down, then a promiscuous tone took over her stinging words. “—I promise I won’t bite!”
ba22bc1938b0.t: Pembantu rumah itu cepat-cepat menyelak beberapa halaman lagi, menggigit bibirnya. Tiba-tiba, matanya yang serius tertumpu pada Harry. “Kau penjaga pintu baru ke, apa? Tutup ajelah, dan datang duduk sebelah aku—” Menghembus keluhan, dia menilai Harry dari atas ke bawah, kemudian nada menggoda mengambil alih kata-katanya yang menyengat. “—Aku janji aku tak gigit!”

bc222c720dc9.en: Harry’s eyes were treated to eye candy from yet another maid. Her unnaturally bright cyan eyes and red lips were unavoidable to look at. Her dark brown hair shone in the dusky glow of the dying afternoon, while her almond skin added a mysterious beauty to her aura. The tight blue corset on top of the black clothing enhanced her natural curviness, and the attention-grabbing power of her breasts—of which Harry’s eyes could not help themselves.
bc222c720dc9.t: Mata Harry dihidangkan dengan pemandangan indah daripada seorang lagi pembantu rumah. Mata biru kehijauannya yang terang luar biasa dan bibir merahnya mustahil untuk tidak dipandang. Rambut coklat gelapnya bersinar dalam cahaya senja petang yang semakin malap, manakala kulitnya yang sawo matang menambahkan kecantikan misteri pada auranya. Korset biru yang ketat di atas pakaian hitam menonjolkan lekuk tubuhnya yang semula jadi, dan kuasa buah dadanya menarik perhatian—yang mana mata Harry tidak dapat menahan diri.

bc376937cd9c.en: The room, now with only a man and a woman was a true realm of possibilities—just like an amusement park, but more physically demanding. The maid’s smirk shone once again as her predator’s eyes saw her prey willingly make his way towards her, tensed up as if he was a male praying mantis mindlessly making a move to mate even though he knew the consequences thereafter.
bc376937cd9c.t: Bilik itu, kini hanya dengan seorang lelaki dan seorang perempuan, benar-benar alam penuh kemungkinan—sama seperti taman tema, tetapi lebih memerlukan tenaga fizikal. Senyum sinis pembantu rumah itu bersinar sekali lagi ketika mata pemangsanya melihat mangsanya dengan rela hati menuju ke arahnya, tegang seolah-olah dia seekor cengkadak jantan yang tanpa berfikir bergerak untuk mengawan walaupun dia tahu akibatnya selepas itu.

bc7400de82ab.en: A small eerie silence claimed the room. Neferteri cleaned her throat as her head barely shook, subtly closing her eyes to go back to enjoy her wine.
bc7400de82ab.t: Kesunyian ganjil yang singkat menguasai bilik itu. Neferteri berdehem sambil kepalanya bergeleng sedikit, memejamkan matanya dengan halus untuk kembali menikmati wainnya.

bd7aa793e71c.en: Itagiba looked at her hand, his body shuffling away from her in what appeared to be an acute shoulder pinch, “Ohh—one of those nights! Sanbi shit!—Okay—okay! I’m going!” Itagiba placed down the empty glass jug, then his hand on the table as he walked around it, drunkenly making his way towards Harry. Almost falling on him as came closer, he then also propped himself on Harry’s chair, putting his face towards Harry's ear.
bd7aa793e71c.t: Itagiba memandang tangannya, tubuhnya mengelak darinya dalam sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti cubitan bahu yang tajam, “Ohh—malam macam tu rupanya! Demi jiwa tua Sanbi!—Okey—okey! Aku pergi!” Itagiba meletakkan jag kaca kosong itu, kemudian tangannya di atas meja sambil berjalan mengelilinginya, terhuyung-hayang dengan mabuk menuju ke arah Harry. Hampir jatuh ke atasnya ketika dia semakin dekat, dia kemudian turut bertongkat pada kerusi Harry, mendekatkan mukanya ke telinga Harry.

bde9b5b0b3a0.en: I guess I don’t. Harry felt those words sting him, as he watched Itagiba about to pour the rest of the beer from the jug into the pitcher, but then just throw the pitcher aside, and drink straight from the jug like a frat boy. Shifting his attention towards Eiri, he saw a tense smile shine on her face, but Harry could feel her eyes had much to say—but they weren’t saying anything, not even a hint. Looking at Sora, Harry only saw that she actively avoided making eye-contact with him, even as to turn her head away when Harry kept on looking. Do I just sign it? But Eiri told me to consider it carefully, but I can’t really understand it—why can’t she just help me? Harry glanced back at the king and queen, waiting for him to simply comply. His muscles were all tensed up, with a large frown mixed with a peaked eyebrow. He felt like he triggered a quick time event, but he didn’t know how long he had to act. His breath was somewhat deep, but his heart pulsated strongly on his chest. He wanted to say yes, but he just couldn’t bring himself to actually do it; such a simple word to say got wedged in his throat, refusing to get out.
bde9b5b0b3a0.t: Rasanya aku tak tahu. Harry merasakan kata-kata itu menyengatnya, ketika dia melihat Itagiba hendak menuang baki bir dari jag ke dalam kendi, tetapi kemudian mencampakkan kendi itu ke tepi, dan minum terus dari jag seperti budak asrama universiti. Mengalihkan perhatiannya kepada Eiri, dia nampak senyuman tegang bersinar di wajahnya, tetapi Harry dapat merasakan matanya mempunyai banyak perkara untuk dikatakan—tetapi mata itu tidak mengatakan apa-apa, sedikit petunjuk pun tidak. Memandang Sora, Harry hanya nampak bahawa dia secara aktif mengelak bertentang mata dengannya, malah sampai memalingkan kepalanya apabila Harry terus memandang. Aku tandatangan je ke? Tapi Eiri suruh aku fikir baik-baik, tapi aku tak berapa faham—kenapa dia tak boleh tolong aku je? Harry mengerling semula raja dan permaisuri, yang menunggu dia sekadar akur. Ototnya semua tegang, dengan kerutan besar bercampur kening yang terangkat. Dia merasakan seolah-olah dia mencetuskan peristiwa masa pantas, tetapi dia tidak tahu berapa lama masa yang dia ada untuk bertindak. Nafasnya agak dalam, tetapi jantungnya berdenyut kuat di dadanya. Dia mahu berkata ya, tetapi dia tidak sanggup benar-benar melakukannya; perkataan yang begitu mudah untuk diucapkan tersekat di kerongkongnya, enggan keluar.

c0283aa19972.en: Chapter IV subchapter 2: a long dining hall with a fish-painted ceiling, many people seated at a red-clothed table.
c0283aa19972.t: Bab IV subbab 2: sebuah dewan makan panjang dengan siling berlukis ikan, ramai orang duduk di meja beralas kain merah.

c0c57af231c9.en: Harry, with pink cream cheese and breadcrumbs on the sides of his mouth, chowed down the last piece of his filling bagel, and accepted Arukia’s.
c0c57af231c9.t: Harry, dengan keju krim merah jambu dan serbuk roti di tepi mulutnya, melahap kepingan terakhir bagelnya yang mengenyangkan, dan menerima bagel Arukia.

c17a8c0488f2.en: A groan came out of Harry, still trying to clean away the juices. In his blurry vision, he saw the two maids at the end of the table. Sora looked like she just had seen an accident, and was moments away from sprinting to help, while the other maid stood up as if nothing had happened.
c17a8c0488f2.t: Satu erangan keluar daripada Harry, masih cuba membersihkan jus itu. Dalam penglihatannya yang kabur, dia nampak dua pembantu rumah di hujung meja. Sora kelihatan seperti baru menyaksikan kemalangan, dan hanya beberapa saat lagi untuk berlari membantu, manakala pembantu rumah yang seorang lagi berdiri seolah-olah tiada apa-apa yang berlaku.

c1ef224e56f1.en: Arukia stood up. “I figured—even her food is bland. Now help me clean this up!” she pointed at the coffee table “I’m going to go get the fost lamp up instead!”
c1ef224e56f1.t: Arukia berdiri. “Dah agak—makanan dia pun tawar. Sekarang tolong aku kemas ni!” dia menunjuk ke arah meja kopi “Aku nak pergi naikkan lampu fost pula!”

c3171b31d6ba.en: Harry looked towards the source of the voice, Nina, but all he saw was ball-shaped fruit flying towards his face, right before it squashed itself like an egg being dropped onto the floor. The fruit exploded on him, revealing black seeds wrapped in a sack of yellow, slightly tangy and sweet juice. Gravity then finished the job by pulling it down towards his nose, before it slumped on his belly, landing on his lap.
c3171b31d6ba.t: Harry memandang ke arah sumber suara itu, Nina, tetapi yang dia nampak hanyalah buah berbentuk bola terbang ke arah mukanya, sebelum ia penyek seperti telur yang dijatuhkan ke lantai. Buah itu meletup padanya, mendedahkan biji hitam yang dibalut dalam kantung jus kuning yang sedikit masam dan manis. Graviti kemudian menyelesaikan kerjanya dengan menariknya ke bawah ke hidungnya, sebelum ia jatuh ke perutnya, mendarat di ribanya.

c3a9274f7072.en: “That’s—different. Hurgh,” Itagiba looked more confused than before, burping a bit loudly before downing another pitch of beer, perhaps trying to make sense of what just came out of Harry’s mouth.
c3a9274f7072.t: “Itu—lain macam. Hurgh,” Itagiba kelihatan lebih keliru daripada tadi, bersendawa agak kuat sebelum meneguk habis sekendi lagi bir, mungkin cuba memahami apa yang baru keluar dari mulut Harry.

c3b504d9fffa.en: Meanwhile, the person beside Harry, a tall girl with a ponytail that kinda looked like Itagiba, but more female, let out a disappointed “Pffft.”
c3b504d9fffa.t: Sementara itu, orang di sebelah Harry, seorang gadis tinggi berekor kuda yang agak menyerupai Itagiba, tetapi lebih kewanitaan, mengeluarkan “Pffft” yang kecewa.

c4cf84f5ccd0.en: With all the maids gone, except for Sora, Eiri picked up a scroll from a red with golden accents couch that fit four people, and unrolled it in front of Harry. It was a fancy glossy paper, with a highly detailed blue border that made the handwritten wall of text in red fancier, albeit contrasting what appeared to be blood spatter mixed with a translucent grain in the bottom left; the bottom right looked eerily spotless though.
c4cf84f5ccd0.t: Dengan semua pembantu rumah sudah pergi, kecuali Sora, Eiri mengambil sebuah skrol dari sofa merah berhias emas yang muat empat orang, dan membukanya di hadapan Harry. Ia kertas berkilat yang mewah, dengan sempadan biru yang sangat terperinci yang membuatkan dinding teks tulisan tangan berwarna merah itu lebih mewah, walaupun berlawanan dengan sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti percikan darah bercampur butiran lut sinar di bahagian bawah kiri; bahagian bawah kanan kelihatan bersih dengan menyeramkan.

c73029518e36.en: “Then I shall confirm with Princess Eori. I appreciate you indulging us thus far.” Neferteri excused herself as well.
c73029518e36.t: “Kalau begitu saya akan mengesahkan dengan Puteri Eori. Saya menghargai kesudian kamu melayan kami setakat ini.” Neferteri turut meminta diri.

c8017dd72e60.en: “I’m sorry!” Nina, the small child in pink, caught his attention away from the conversation. Her teary eyes looked back and forth between Harry and her mother, the queen. She grabbed a picker with each hand, eagerly awaiting what was gonna come next from her mother, Neferteri.
c8017dd72e60.t: “Maaf!” Nina, kanak-kanak kecil berbaju merah jambu, menarik perhatiannya dari perbualan itu. Matanya yang berair memandang silih berganti antara Harry dan ibunya, permaisuri. Dia memegang sebatang picker di setiap tangan, menunggu dengan tidak sabar apa yang akan datang seterusnya daripada ibunya, Neferteri.

c8ea9f67f13b.en: Maiara sulked as her purple eyes stared back at Neferteri’s, enjoying her wine. “You want an introduction? Okay.” The sulk in her lips transformed into a sure Itagiba-like smirk, her eyes now impishly glared towards Harry’s, appreciating his apparent immeasurable sex appeal: his faint neckbeard, barely visible mustache complemented the unconfident look in his face. His large gut, nearly exploding out of his shirt, drew enough attention to itself, but then there was the exposed hairy belly button also fighting for attention. Finally, the wet towel with yellow stains and black seeds resting on his lap showing a bulge in his tight pants was the final touch in creating this vision of a dream man—for someone, maybe a very specific individual somewhere in the four corners of the world.
c8ea9f67f13b.t: Maiara merajuk sementara mata ungunya merenung balik mata Neferteri, yang sedang menikmati wainnya. “Mak nak perkenalan? Okey.” Rajuk di bibirnya bertukar menjadi senyum sinis yakin seperti Itagiba, matanya kini menjeling nakal ke arah mata Harry, menghargai daya tarikan seksualnya yang nampaknya tidak terkira: janggut leher yang samar, misai yang hampir tidak kelihatan melengkapi riak tidak yakin di wajahnya. Perutnya yang besar, hampir meletup keluar dari bajunya, cukup menarik perhatian, tetapi kemudian ada pula pusat berbulu yang terdedah turut bersaing untuk mendapat perhatian. Akhir sekali, tuala basah dengan kesan kuning dan biji hitam yang terletak di ribanya menunjukkan bonjolan dalam seluarnya yang ketat ialah sentuhan terakhir dalam mencipta bayangan lelaki idaman ini—bagi seseorang, mungkin individu yang sangat khusus di suatu tempat di empat penjuru dunia.

c9b45f1729fb.en: With his internal intuition screaming at him—or maybe it was just a shot of adrenaline that sped up his heartbeat, Harry looked to the spiraling stairs, devoid of life, then back at her seductive red lips. Do it! Do it! An even higher voice inside him told to be a man. His mind, racing with possibilities, followed after this maid’s request, and saw the stairs disappear behind the door closing, by his own eager, but skittish hand.
c9b45f1729fb.t: Dengan gerak hatinya menjerit kepadanya—atau mungkin itu cuma suntikan adrenalina yang melajukan degupan jantungnya, Harry memandang tangga berpusar yang kosong tanpa kehidupan, kemudian kembali ke bibir merahnya yang menggoda. Buat! Buat! Satu suara yang lebih tinggi dalam dirinya menyuruhnya menjadi lelaki. Fikirannya, berlumba dengan pelbagai kemungkinan, menurut permintaan pembantu rumah ini, dan melihat tangga itu hilang di sebalik pintu yang ditutup, oleh tangannya sendiri yang bersemangat tetapi gementar.

cac96802482b.en: Eiri whistled twice, and soon after a gleeful older lady with thicker proportions, and well-endowed breasts—which she was not afraid to show off—appeared. She also wore the usual black and blue maid clothing, but she also had a red thatch hat, and caramel-colored short hair. She extended her empty hand towards Harry while carrying a large bucket with the other. “Need another towel, honey?”
cac96802482b.t: Eiri bersiul dua kali, dan tidak lama kemudian seorang wanita tua yang riang dengan badan lebih berisi, dan buah dada yang besar—yang tidak segan ditunjukkannya—muncul. Dia juga memakai pakaian pembantu rumah hitam dan biru yang biasa, tetapi dia turut memakai topi jerami merah, dan berambut pendek berwarna karamel. Dia menghulurkan tangannya yang kosong ke arah Harry sambil membawa sebaldi besar dengan tangan yang lagi satu. “Nak tuala lagi, nak?”

caffd748da8c.en: So nobody knows about that after all? With an estranged smile, Harry felt something odd with the tea—maybe the strong smell akin to air fresheners was to blame, but as he watched Arukia take a sip, he followed along; his palate first noticed the chunkiness of the tea—like drinking poorly mixed chocolate syrup and milk, followed by a diabetic knockout punch on his tongue, throat, and stomach. The aftertaste felt like a slap in the face by a citrusy flavor that was close to chewing on multiple fresh orange crusts. Harry soured his face, waiting for his stomach to survive the storm, teetering on the edge of transforming his esophagus into a hose, and destroying any goodwill he had for daring to drink the tea in the first place.
caffd748da8c.t: Jadi memang tak ada sesiapa yang tahu pasal tu? Dengan senyuman janggal, Harry merasakan sesuatu yang aneh dengan teh itu—mungkin bau kuat seperti penyegar udara yang patut dipersalahkan, tetapi ketika dia melihat Arukia menghirupnya, dia turut menghirup; lelangitnya mula-mula perasan teh itu berketul-ketul—seperti minum sirap coklat dan susu yang tidak dikacau dengan betul, diikuti tumbukan kencing manis yang menumbangkan di lidah, kerongkong dan perutnya. Rasa akhirnya terasa seperti ditampar oleh rasa sitrus yang hampir seperti mengunyah beberapa kulit oren segar. Harry memasamkan muka, menunggu perutnya bertahan dalam ribut itu, terumbang-ambing di ambang mengubah esofagusnya menjadi hos, dan memusnahkan segala niat baik yang dimilikinya kerana berani minum teh itu pada mulanya.

cc54bfb3fa3b.en: “Apologies for my husband, as he overindulges on occasion.” Neferteri, standing behind her own chair, gripped the top as if she was about to snap a piece right off, yet her expression remained just as peaceful, and elegant as one would expect.
cc54bfb3fa3b.t: “Maafkan suami saya, kerana dia sesekali terlebih memanjakan diri.” Neferteri, berdiri di belakang kerusinya sendiri, mencengkam bahagian atasnya seolah-olah dia hendak mematahkan sekeping, namun riaknya kekal tenang dan anggun seperti yang dijangka.

ced698c0d057.en: “Sorry for what? It’s his fault for being a fat pussy!” A womanly voice, sounding like a female version of Itagiba, spoke loudly in the room, tearing through all the ongoing conversations.
ced698c0d057.t: “Minta maaf untuk apa? Salah dia sebab jadi pondan gemuk!” Suara wanita, kedengaran seperti versi perempuan Itagiba, bercakap dengan kuat dalam bilik itu, merobek semua perbualan yang sedang berlangsung.

cf07c0a98d4c.en: Harry’s eyes were treated to eye candy from yet another maid. Her unnaturally bright cyan eyes and red lips were unavoidable to look at.
cf07c0a98d4c.t: Mata Harry dihidangkan dengan pemandangan indah daripada seorang lagi pembantu rumah. Mata biru kehijauannya yang terang luar biasa dan bibir merahnya mustahil untuk tidak dipandang.

d01ab7d30e7f.en: Itagiba shooed Neferteri’s hand away. “Nah—I’m fine. It’s my fault I did not have a cute son for Harry. I FUCKING TRIED, ALL RIGHT?” Itagiba cleaned away a manly tear running down his cheek.
d01ab7d30e7f.t: Itagiba menepis tangan Neferteri. “Tak—aku okey. Salah aku sebab tak ada anak lelaki comel untuk Harry. AKU DAH CUBA, OKEY?” Itagiba mengesat air mata jantan yang mengalir di pipinya.

d135b8265de8.en: Taking a sip of her wine, Neferteri, spoke softly. “Bathe her first.''
d135b8265de8.t: Menghirup wainnya, Neferteri bercakap dengan lembut. “Mandikan dia dahulu.''

d3a6ed5a2d7b.en: Neferteri stood up, closing her eyes tightly, taking a deep breath, as the rest of her body remained elegant and courteous. “Dear—you had too much to drink.”
d3a6ed5a2d7b.t: Neferteri berdiri, memejamkan matanya rapat-rapat, menarik nafas dalam, sementara bahagian lain tubuhnya kekal anggun dan sopan. “Kanda—kanda sudah terlebih minum.”

d3d3e65fc64e.en: “MY RAKUJA! AHHHH!” Nina exclaimed with despair as Maiara chucked the remains of the rakuja right in front of her, making a sloppy wet sound. She picked it up with teary eyes as if it were the remains of her own son. Lifting it off the table, the remains then broke in half, and splashed back on the table—Nina lost it, and started bawling like a little baby.
d3d3e65fc64e.t: “RAKUJA NINA! AHHHH!” Nina berseru dengan putus asa ketika Maiara mencampakkan sisa rakuja itu betul-betul di depannya, mengeluarkan bunyi basah yang selekeh. Dia mengambilnya dengan mata berair seolah-olah itu sisa anaknya sendiri. Mengangkatnya dari meja, sisa itu kemudian terbelah dua, dan terpercik semula ke atas meja—Nina hilang kawalan, dan mula meraung seperti bayi kecil.

d551932bf60b.en: “Poor you—it must be tough dealing with a soul death.” The maid flipped a few more pages, looking for something specific: A house-sized red wooden statue of three corpulent ladies seated by one another in the middle of a roundabout, looking cheerful to passerby. They wore pink bikinis, except the middle one also had a pink hat with a bright reddish tree on it. Even though it was a statue, one could still feel a welcome warmth from them—like visiting grandma, and she tells you that your favorite dessert is ready for you in the kitchen. “This ring any bells?” Arukia tapped on the drawing of the sisters.
d551932bf60b.t: “Kesian kau—mesti susah nak hadapi mati jiwa.” Pembantu rumah itu menyelak beberapa halaman lagi, mencari sesuatu yang khusus: patung kayu merah sebesar rumah tiga wanita gempal yang duduk bersebelahan di tengah-tengah bulatan jalan, kelihatan ceria kepada orang yang lalu-lalang. Mereka memakai bikini merah jambu, kecuali yang tengah juga memakai topi merah jambu dengan pokok kemerahan terang di atasnya. Walaupun hanya patung, orang masih dapat merasakan kehangatan yang mesra daripada mereka—seperti melawat nenek, dan dia memberitahu pencuci mulut kegemaran kau sudah tersedia di dapur. “Ada ingat apa-apa?” Arukia mengetuk lukisan adik-beradik perempuan itu.

d5d283491a96.en: Squinting towards the book, his eyes could make a bit of sense of what the map was, but it clearly looked foreigner to him. “I’m—I’m not sure—I didn’t know there were multiple of them.” With a heavy breath, Harry tried his best to look at the maid’s rather unnaturally bright cyan eyes, rather than her breasts, but there’s only so much willpower a man could muster before his soul caved in.
d5d283491a96.t: Mengecilkan mata ke arah buku itu, matanya dapat memahami sedikit apa peta itu, tetapi ia jelas kelihatan asing baginya. “Sa—saya tak pasti—saya tak tahu pun ada banyak setinggan.” Dengan nafas berat, Harry cuba sedaya upaya memandang mata biru kehijauan pembantu rumah itu yang agak terang luar biasa, dan bukannya buah dadanya, tetapi ada had kekuatan jiwa yang mampu dikumpul seorang lelaki sebelum jiwanya runtuh.

dcd0d53065d3.en: “I’m good, thank you.” Harry slightly smiled back, imagining Nina stabbing his arm if he dared to take one. Plus, his belly felt full to the brim from two dinners in a row—he couldn’t help himself to a few more bagels.
dcd0d53065d3.t: “Tak apa, terima kasih.” Harry tersenyum sedikit, membayangkan Nina menikam lengannya jika dia berani mengambil sebiji. Tambahan pula, perutnya terasa penuh hingga ke tekak kerana dua kali makan malam berturut-turut—dia tidak dapat menahan diri daripada beberapa biji bagel lagi.

dd36c19d6861.en: “Argh. Whatever! How is this supposed to even help you?” She caught herself slipping again into a sharpened tongue. “—I knew you would be feeling meh after the resuscitation! Eiri told us all about it!”
dd36c19d6861.t: “Argh. Lantaklah! Macam mana benda ni nak tolong kau?” Dia tersedar dirinya tergelincir lagi ke lidah yang tajam. “—Aku tahu kau mesti rasa tak bermaya lepas resusitasi! Eiri dah cerita semuanya kat kami!”

defadf011c0b.en: The area surrounding Maiara became a splash zone of a theme park attraction; Harry and Kibe were the biggest casualties aside from Maiara's own hair and clothes.
defadf011c0b.t: Kawasan sekeliling Maiara menjadi zon percikan tarikan taman tema; Harry dan Kibe menjadi mangsa terbesar selain rambut dan pakaian Maiara sendiri.

dfbfd89ee893.en: “Where?” Harry widened eyes and suspenseful face accompanied his suddenly demanding tone.
dfbfd89ee893.t: “Kat mana?” Mata Harry yang terbeliak dan wajahnya yang penuh debar mengiringi nadanya yang tiba-tiba mendesak.

dfcf87bad162.en: Harry’s feet moved on their own, but instead of walking towards those doors, he walked downstairs, and out of the castle. In the courtyard, by the two doors he had just come out of, he saw two fost lamps. A bright light in the shape of a stone stood at the bottom of a glass container, emitting a bright white light. Around it, he could see bubbling around the stone constantly forming, releasing constant steam towards the surface. Those fost lamps are everywhere, but I never saw them before—or I guess I don’t remember them at all—but how would I forget something like that, but remember a bunch of weird crap?
dfcf87bad162.t: Kaki Harry bergerak sendiri, tetapi bukannya berjalan ke arah pintu-pintu itu, dia turun ke bawah, dan keluar dari istana. Di halaman, di tepi dua pintu yang baru dia keluari, dia nampak dua lampu fost. Cahaya terang berbentuk batu terletak di dasar bekas kaca, memancarkan cahaya putih terang. Di sekelilingnya, dia dapat melihat gelembung di sekitar batu itu sentiasa terbentuk, melepaskan wap berterusan ke permukaan. Lampu fost ni ada kat mana-mana, tapi aku tak pernah nampak sebelum ni—atau rasanya aku langsung tak ingat—tapi macam mana aku boleh lupa benda macam tu, tapi ingat banyak benda karut yang pelik?

e0614288ac9b.en: Enjoyingly taking her time emptying the blue basket, her hands coincidentally became clumsy at one point, and she happened to drop an empty cup on the floor. Quickly picking it up, she arched her back along the way.
e0614288ac9b.t: Sambil menikmati masanya mengosongkan bakul biru itu, tangannya secara kebetulan menjadi kekok pada satu ketika, dan dia terjatuhkan sebiji cawan kosong ke lantai. Cepat-cepat memungutnya, dia melengkungkan belakangnya dalam proses itu.

e57d9cbeee2d.en: Maiara bent backwards on the table to take a good look at Princess Eori. “Bitch—what did you say?”
e57d9cbeee2d.t: Maiara membongkok ke belakang di meja untuk melihat Puteri Eori dengan jelas. “Perempuan sundal—kau cakap apa?”

e77a00d0be80.en: “Yeah— That’s my name—I think.” Harry felt like he wanted to get up, and get some fresh air. His adrenaline was like drinking five cups of coffee, and feeling an urge to walk about all day long.
e77a00d0be80.t: “Ha— Itu nama saya—rasanya.” Harry merasa seperti mahu bangun, dan menghirup udara segar. Adrenalinanya seperti minum lima cawan kopi, dan merasakan desakan untuk berjalan-jalan sepanjang hari.

e9ac34e2d5e1.en: The fruit made a loud thud as it exploded on Eori’s soft, spotless cheek like a good punch. Eori’s body slumped to the empty seat beside her, giving Maiara a win by a technical knockout—at least for a few seconds before Eori wobblily sat back up, getting her bearings of where she was.
e9ac34e2d5e1.t: Buah itu berbunyi kuat ketika ia meletup pada pipi Eori yang lembut dan tanpa cela seperti tumbukan yang padu. Tubuh Eori terkulai ke kerusi kosong di sebelahnya, memberikan Maiara kemenangan secara kalah mati teknikal—sekurang-kurangnya selama beberapa saat sebelum Eori duduk semula terhuyung-hayang, cuba memahami di mana dia berada.

ee10676061d7.en: “Urgh. That’s my backup uniform!” Kibe touched his uniform, stained all over with the yellow juice and seeds. He touched his hair next, and felt the same stickiness. With a grunt, he moved his chair back, and walked off mumbling to himself.
ee10676061d7.t: “Urgh. Itu seragam simpanan aku!” Kibe menyentuh seragamnya, bertompok di merata tempat dengan jus kuning dan biji. Dia menyentuh rambutnya pula, dan merasakan kelekitan yang sama. Dengan rengusan, dia menolak kerusinya ke belakang, dan berjalan pergi sambil bergumam sendirian.

ee8f28c20d2a.en: “Are you a cartography buff?” The maid, curling up her hair with her finger, asked point blank, holding one of the half-turned pages as she glanced at Harry. One of the visible pages had a drawn picture of a large black castle with accents in red, blue, green, and yellow that poked the blue sky—at least that’s the feel it was given by whoever drew it from the ground angle.
ee8f28c20d2a.t: “Kau peminat kartografi ke?” Pembantu rumah itu, memintal rambutnya dengan jari, bertanya terus terang, memegang salah satu halaman yang separuh diselak sambil mengerling Harry. Salah satu halaman yang kelihatan mempunyai lukisan sebuah istana hitam besar berhias merah, biru, hijau dan kuning yang menjulang ke langit biru—sekurang-kurangnya itulah rasa yang diberikan oleh sesiapa yang melukisnya dari sudut tanah.

ef95b7531574.en: Itanema, the maid with long black hair and freckles, was now in the splash zone, as her upper uniform got soaked with juices. She looked at it, then ignored the griminess as if it wasn’t her first rodeo.
ef95b7531574.t: Itanema, pembantu rumah berambut hitam panjang dan berjeragat, kini berada dalam zon percikan, kerana seragam atasnya basah dengan jus. Dia memandangnya, kemudian tidak mengendahkan kekotoran itu seolah-olah ini bukan kali pertamanya.

efe1e68249ce.en: Feeling her breath and warmth encroaching him from the side, Harry snapped his neck towards her. “You—you know it as well?” His spirits seemed to have renewed itself, no longer paying as much attention to the pleasures of the flesh.
efe1e68249ce.t: Merasakan nafas dan kehangatannya menghimpitnya dari sisi, Harry menyentap lehernya ke arahnya. “Awak—awak pun tahu?” Semangatnya seakan-akan diperbaharui, tidak lagi terlalu memberi perhatian kepada nikmat daging.

f257a7055500.en: Eiri looked around the table, then towards Harry. Her lips formed an estranged smile, “Need anything else, Harry? We do have desserts too, even rakujas if you want to try them.” She looked at Nina’s unprotected plate, with some untouched rakujas.
f257a7055500.t: Eiri memandang sekeliling meja, kemudian ke arah Harry. Bibirnya membentuk senyuman janggal, “Perlukan apa-apa lagi, Harry? Kami ada pencuci mulut juga, rakuja pun ada kalau kau nak cuba.” Dia memandang pinggan Nina yang tidak dijaga, dengan beberapa biji rakuja yang tidak terusik.

f29e7d235273.en: Meanwhile, Eiri, in a fancy maid dress sitting across from Harry, put down her beer pitcher. “You okay, Harry? Itanema, please get him two wet towels.”
f29e7d235273.t: Sementara itu, Eiri, dalam gaun pembantu rumah yang mewah duduk bertentangan dengan Harry, meletakkan kendi birnya. “Kau okey, Harry? Itanema, tolong ambilkan dia dua tuala basah.”

f387bec0790f.en: Frozen, Harry speechlessly looked at the king of Sanbi kingdom, looking at him with flaring nostrils and bulging eyes.
f387bec0790f.t: Membeku, Harry memandang tanpa kata raja kerajaan Sanbi, yang memandangnya dengan lubang hidung kembang dan mata terbeliak.

f55f2298813c.en: “You really liked that? Ewww.” Arukia cleaned her lips with a small towel from the bag, sitting back, and ensuring she was scooching skin-to-skin with Harry.
f55f2298813c.t: “Kau betul-betul suka benda tu? Eee.” Arukia membersihkan bibirnya dengan tuala kecil dari beg itu, bersandar semula, dan memastikan dia mengesot rapat kulit ke kulit dengan Harry.

f58d17d4a76f.en: With another “tsk,” Arukia peeked behind her, towards the window where the sun was quickly dying down, leaving orangish hard shadows throughout the room. Leaning forward, she placed down her cup and opened a bag of bagels.
f58d17d4a76f.t: Dengan satu lagi “cis,” Arukia mengintai ke belakangnya, ke arah tingkap di mana matahari cepat terbenam, meninggalkan bayang-bayang keras kejinggaan di seluruh bilik. Membongkok ke depan, dia meletakkan cawannya dan membuka beg berisi bagel.

fab5ff2c19ea.en: “N–no.” Harry focused his attention on the book laying on her lap.
fab5ff2c19ea.t: “T–tak.” Harry menumpukan perhatiannya pada buku yang terletak di ribanya.

fc19dbad4e38.en: Pausing his breath, Harry, still standing by the open door, focused his mind completely on acquiring the mental imagery of that “raw” instant. His mind went into imagination land, and he clearly saw himself closing the door, approaching her with full-handed butt slap, then sticking it into her right there and then until the sun went down. In reality, he stood by the open door, salivating at the thought as his hand gripped the handle.
fc19dbad4e38.t: Menahan nafas, Harry, masih berdiri di tepi pintu yang terbuka, menumpukan fikirannya sepenuhnya untuk merakam imej mental saat yang “mentah” itu. Fikirannya melayang ke alam khayalan, dan dia jelas melihat dirinya menutup pintu, mendekatinya dengan tamparan punggung sepenuh tapak tangan, kemudian menjolok di situ juga sehingga matahari terbenam. Hakikatnya, dia berdiri di tepi pintu yang terbuka, meleleh air liur memikirkannya sementara tangannya menggenggam tombol.
